a: Bechol tame lo yeachel", mi la askinan denaga besheni. revii mikkal vachomer, kidamrinan.
Vei salka datach savar kerabbi akiva, nitne name: revii batteruma vachamishi bakkodesh.
Ella rabbi akiva la savar kerabbi yose menalan?
Amar leh: dela lishtemit tanna velitne revii batteruma vachamishi bakkodesh, venema rabbi akiva hi. vaanan ahachi nekum venismoch?!
Nefak rav ashe, vei tema rav kahana, dak veashkach ha ditnan: hakkeli metzaref et ma shebbetocho lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma. veharvii bakkodesh pasul, vehashshelishi batteruma.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: meeduto shel rabbi akiva nishnet mishna zo. (detanya:) hosif rabbi akiva hassolet vehakketoret vehallevona vehaggechalim, sheim naga tevul yom bemiktzatan pasal et kullan.
Revii in, chamishi la. shelishi in, revii la.
Alma kasavar: tzeruf derabbanan. ufeliga derabbi chanin, deamar: tzeruf deorayyta, shenneemar: "kaf achat asara zahav melea ketoret", hakkatuv asa kol ma shebbakkaf achat.
Tenan hatam: al machat shennimtzet babbasar, shehassakkin vehayyadayim — tehorot, vehabbasar tame. nimtzet bapperesh — hakkol tahor. amar rabbi akiva: zachinu sheen tumeat yadayim bammikdash.
b: Venema: sheen tumeat yadayim vechelim bammikdash! amar rav yehuda amar rav, veittema rabbi yose berabbi chanina: yadayim kodem gezerat kelim nishnu.
Amar rava: veha tarvayyhu bo bayyom gazru, ditnan: hassefer vehayyadayim vehattevul yom vehaochalin vehakkelim shennitmeu bemashkin!
Ella amar rava: hannach letumeat sakkin, daafillu bechullin name la metamme. hay sakkin dinga bemay? ilema dinga bevasar — ha en ochel metamme keli, veella dinga bemachat — veha en keli metamme keli!

Hay machat may avidteh? i nema sefek machat, veha ittemar: rabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina, chad amar: lo gazru al sefek harukkin shebbirushalayim, vechad amar: lo gazru al sefek hakkelim shebbirushalayim.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kegon sheavda lo machat teme met, vehikkirah babbasar. rabbi yose berabbi avin amar: kegon shehayta para chasuma, uvaa michutz lirushalayim.
Gufa. rabbi elazar verabbi yose berabbi chanina, chad amar: lo gazru al sefek harukkin shebbirushalayim, vechad amar: lo gazru al sefek hakkelim shebbirushalayim. rukkin tenena, kelim tenena!
Rukkin tenena, ditnan: kol harukkin hannimtzain birushalayim tehorin, chutz mishshel shuk haelyon! la tzericha, af al gav deittachzak zav.
Kelim tenena, ditnan: kol hakkelim hannimtzaim birushalayim, derech yerida levet hattevila — temein. ha dealma — tehorin!
Uletamaych, ema sefa: derech aliyya — tehorin. ha dealma — temein!
Ella: resha davka, vesefa lav davka. uleappoke gazyayta.
Ulerav deamar: kegon sheavda lo machat teme met vehikkirah babbasar, kevan deamar mar: "bachalal cherev", cherev hare hu kechalal — adam vechelim name litamme!
Amar rav ashe: zot omeret azara reshut harabbim hi, vehave leh sefek tumea birshut harabbim. vechol sefek tumea birshut harabbim — sefeko tahor.
Ha birshut hayyachid — sefeko tame hu. mikkede hay machat davar sheen bo daat lishshael hu. vechol davar sheen bo daat lishshael, ben birshut harabbim ben birshut hayyachid — sefeko tahor!
Mishshum dehave sefek tumea habbaa bide adam, veamar rabbi yochanan: sefek tumea habbaa bide adam

a: Nishalin aleha, afillu bichli hammunnach al gabbe karka — kedavar sheyyesh bo daat lishshael.
"Vehabbasar tame". hay basar deittachshar bemay?

I nema deittachshar bedam, veha amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir — shenneemar: "lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim", dam shennishpach kammayim — machshir, vesheeno nishpach kammayim — eno machshir.
Veella deittachshar bemashke bet matbechayya. veha amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: mashke bet matbechayya lo dayyayn shehen dechan, ella sheen machshirin!
Veella deittachshar bechibbat hakkodesh. emor demahneya leh chibbat hakkodesh leippesole gufeh, lemimne beh rishon vesheni name?!
Tifshot devae resh lakish: tzarid shel menachot monin bo rishon vesheni o lo!
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kegon shehayta para shel zivche shelamim, veheevirah benahar ushechatah, vaadayin mashke tofeach aleha.
Nimtzet bapperesh — hakkol tahor. venihdar peresh venitammeye levasar! amar rav adda bar ahava: beferesh ava. rav ashe amar: afillu tema beferesh rakka, mishshum dehave mashke saruach.

Tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: sheretz metamme et hammashkin, umashkin metammein et hakkeli, ucheli metamme et haochalin, vehaochalin metammein et hammashkin. velamadnu shalosh tumeot besheretz. hane arbaa hen! goz mashkin deresha.
Adderabba, goz mashkin desefa! la ashkechan tanna deamar "mashkin metammein keli" ella rabbi yehuda, vahadar beh. vesimanaych: nazyeyta.
Tenan hatam: sheretz shennimtza betannur — happat shebbetocho sheniyya, mippene shehattannur techilla.
Amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: venichze lehay tannur keman dimle tumea dame, vetihve hay pat rishona!
Amar leh: la salka datach, detanya: yachol yehu kol hakkelim mittammein meavir keli cheres —
b: Talmud lomar: "kol asher betocho yitma", usemich leh: "mikkol haochel". ochel mittamme meavir keli cheres, veen kol hakkelim mittammein meavir keli cheres.
Rav chisda rame pischa appischa umeshanne: mi amar rabbi yehoshua shetehen keachat?

Ureminhu, amar rabbi yose: en hanniddon dome liraya, kesheheidu rabbotenu — al ma heidu? im al habbasar shennitma bivlad hattumea shessorfin oto im habbasar shennitma beav hattumea — ze tame veze tame.

Im al hashshemen shennifsal bitvul yom, shemmadlikin oto bener shennitma bitme met — ze pasul veze tame. af anu modim bitruma shennitmet bivlad hattumea shessorfin otah im hatteruma shennitmet beav hattumea, aval heach nisrof afillu teluya im hattemea, shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharem.
Umeshanne: ha rabbi shimon, veallibba derabbi yehoshua. ha rabbi yose, veallibba derabbi yehoshua.

Detanya: arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat, mevaarin et hakkol millifne hashshabbat, vesorfin terumot temeot teluyot utehorot, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: tehora bifne atzmah, uteluya bifne atzmah, utemea bifne atzmah.

Amar rabbi shimon: lo nechleku rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua al hattehora veal hattemea sheen sorfin, al hatteluya veal hattehora shessorfin. al ma nechleku — al hatteluya veal hattemea, sherabbi eliezer omer: tissaref zo beatzmah vezo beatzmah. verabbi yehoshua omer: shetehen keachat.
Veha matnitin rabbi yose hi! hachi kaamar rabbi yose lerabbi meir: afillu rabbi shimon veallibba derabbi yehoshua, demekel, ki mekel bitluya utemea, aval bithora utemea — la.
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina rame teruma appischa, umeshanne: mi amar rabbi yehoshua shetehen keachat?

Ureminhu: chavit shel teruma shennolad bah sefek tumea, rabbi eliezer omer: im hayta munnachat bimkom hatturepa — yannichenna bemakom hammutzena, veim hayta megulla yechassenna. rabbi yehoshua omer: im hayta munnachat bemakom hammutzena — yannichenna bimkom hatturepa, veim hayta mechusse yegallenna.
Gerama — in, beyadayim — la! umeshanne: ha rabbi shimon allibba derabbi yehoshua, ha rabbi yose allibba derabbi yehoshua.
Rabbi elazar rame teruma atteruma, umeshanne: mi amar rabbi yehoshua gerama in, beyadayim la?
Ureminhu: chavit shel teruma shennishbera baggat haelyona vetachteha chullin temein —
Mode rabbi eliezer (lerabbi) yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora — yatztzil, veim lav — rabbi eliezer omer: tered vetittamme, veal yetammeenna bayyad.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: yetammeenna bayyad!
Umeshanne: shane hatam deikka hefsed chullin.
Matkef la rava: matnitin name ikka hefsed etzim! amar leh abbaye: lehefsed merubbe — chashshu, lehefsed muat — lo chashshu.

Vmna temra dilhefsed merubbe chashshu, ulehefsed muat lo chashshu, detanya: chavit shel shemen teruma shennishbera baggat haelyona, uvattachtona chullin temein — mode rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora — yatztzil, veim lav — tered vetittamme veal yetammeenna bayyad.
May shena shemen, derauy lehadelik? yayin name rauy lezilluf!
Vechi tema zilluf lav milleta hi, vehaamar shemuel mishshum rabbi chiyyay: shotin millog besela, umezallefin millog bishtayim! bechadash.
Veha rauy leyashsheno! ate beh lide takkala. shemen name, ate beh lide takkala!
Derame leh bichli maus. yayin name, rame leh bichli maus! lezilluf ka vae leh, bichli maus rame leh?!
Vetakkala atzmah, tannae hi. detanya: chavit shel yayin shel teruma shennitmet, bet shammay omrim: tishshafech chaval, uvet hillel omrim: tease zilluf.
Amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, ani achria: bassade — tishshafech chaval, babbayit — tease zilluf. ikka deamri: bechadash — tishshafech chaval, beyashan — tease zilluf. amru lo:

a: En hacheraat shelishit machraat.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: machloket shennafla lefachot mimmea sea chullin temein.
Aval nafla lemea chullin temein — divre hakkol tered vetittamme, veal yetammeenna bayyad.

Tanya name hachi: chavit shennishbera baggat haelyona, vetachteha mea chullin temein — mode rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora — yatztzil, veim lav — tered vetittamme veal yetammeenna bayyad.
Hay "mode rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua", mode rabbi yehoshua lerabbi eliezer mibbee leh! amar rava: efoch.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar, leolam la tefoch: hacha bemay askinan — bichli shettocho tahor vegabbo tame. mahu detema nigzor dilma naga gabbo bitruma, ka mashma lan.
Haderan alach or learbaa asar

Mishna kol shaa shemmuttar leechol, maachil labbehema lachayya velaofot, umocher lannochri, umuttar bahanaato. avar zemanno — asur bahanaato, velo yassik bo tannur vechirayim. rabbi yehuda omer: en biur chametz ella serefa. vachachamim omrim: af mefarer vezore leruach o metil layyam.

Gemara kol shaa shemmuttar leechol — maachil, ha kol shaa sheeno muttar leechol — eno maachil. lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda. dei rabbi yehuda, ha ikka chamesh deeno ochel — umaachil. ditnan, rabbi meir omer: ochlin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh. rabbi yehuda omer: ochlin kol arba, vetolin kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh!
Veella may, rabbi meir hi? hay "kol shaa shemmuttar leechol maachil" — "kol shaa sheochel maachil" mibbee leh.

Amar rabba bar ulla: matnitin rabban gamliel hi. ditnan, rabban gamliel omer: chullin neechalin kol arba, teruma kol chamesh, vesorfin bitchillat shesh. vehachi kaamar: kol shaa shemmuttar leechol kohen bitruma, yisrael maachil chullin labbehema lachayya velaofot.
Lema li lemitna behema, lema li lemitna chayya? tzericha. dei tena behema — dei meshayyeyra chaze la. aval chayya, dei meshayyeyra kamatznea la — ema la.
Vei tena chayya — mishshum dei meshayyeyra mihat matznea. aval behema, zimnin dimshayyeyra vela massek addateh, vekae aleh beval yerae uveval yimmatze" — ema la, tzericha.
Ofot lema li? ayyeyde ditna behema vechayya, tena name ofot.

Umochro legoy. peshita! leappoke mehay tanna detanya, bet shammay omrim: lo yimkor adam chametzo legoy ella im ken yodea bo sheyyichle kodem pesach. uvet hillel omrim: kol shaa shemmuttar leechol — muttar limkor.
b: Rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: kuttach vechol mine chuttach — asur limkor sheloshim yom kodem lappesach.
Umuttar bahanaa. peshita! la tzericha shecharacho kodem zemanno. veka mashma lan kidrava, deamar rava: characho kodem zemanno — muttar bahanaa afillu leachar zemanno.

Avar zemanno asur bahanaato. peshita! la tzericha, leshaot derabbanan. deamar rav giddel amar rav chiyyay bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: hamekaddesh mishshesh shaot ulemala, afillu bechitte kuredinyata — en choshshin lekiddushin.

Velo yassik bo tannur vechirayim. peshita! la tzericha, lerabbi yehuda deamar en biur chametz ella serefa. salka datach amena: hoil veamar rabbi yehuda mitzvato bisrefa, bahade deka saref leh lithane minneh, ka mashma lan.

Amar chizkiyya: minnayin lechametz bappesach sheasur bahanaa? shenneemar "lo yeachel chametz" — lo yehe bo hetter achila: tama dichtav rachamana "lo yeachel chametz", ha la ketav "lo yeachel", hava amena: issur achila — mashma, issur hanaa — la mashma.

Ufeliga derabbi avahu. deamar rabbi avahu: kol makom shenneemar "lo yeachel", "lo tochal", "lo tochlu" — echad issur achila veechad issur hanaa (mashma), ad sheyyifrot lecha hakkatuv kederech shepparat lecha binvela.

Detanya: "lo tochlu kol nevela lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenochri vegomer", en li ella lagger bintina velaggoy bimchira. lagger bimchira minnayin? talmud lomar: "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna o machor". laggoy bintina minnayin? talmud lomar: "tittenenna vaachalah o machor lenachri". nimtzeta omer: echad ger veechad goy, ben bimchira ben bintina, divre rabbi meir.

Rabbi yehuda omer, devarim kichtavan: lagger bintina velaggoy bimchira. may tama derabbi yehuda? i salka datach kidamar rabbi meir, lichtov rachamana: "lagger asher bisharecha tittenenna vaachalah umachor". "o" lema li? shema minna lidvarim kichtavan.
Verabbi meir? "o" lehakedim netina deger limchira degoy. verabbi yehuda? ha la tzarich kera: kevan deger atta metzuvvev lehacheyoto, vegoy i atta metzuvvev lehachayoto, la tzerich kera, sevara hu.
Bishlama lerabbi meir, deamar: echad ger veechad goy, ben bimchira ben bintina. middeitzterich kera lemishre nevela bahanaa — ha kol issurin shebbattora asurin ben baachila ben bahanaa.
Ella lerabbi yehuda, deamar: lidvarim kichtavan hu daata — ha kol issurim shebbattora mena leh daasurin bahanaa? nafka leh millakkelev tashlichun oto".

a: Oto atta mashlich lakkelev, vei atta mashlich lakkelev kol issurin shebbattora. verabbi meir? oto atta mashlich lakkelev, vei atta mashlich lakkelev chullin shennishchatu baazara.
Veiddach? chullin shennishchatu baazara lav deorayyta hi.

Metiv rabbi yitzchak nappacha: vahare gid hannashe, derachamana amar: "al ken lo yochlu vene yisrael et gid hannashe", utenan: sholeach adam yarech legoy, vegid hannashe betocho, mippene shemmekomo nikkar!
Kasavar rabbi avahu: keshehuttera nevela — hi vechelbah vegidah huttera. hanicha leman deamar "yesh begidin benoten taam". ella leman deamar "en begidin benoten taam", may ikka lememar?
Man shamat leh deamar "en begidin benoten taam" rabbi shimon, detanya: haochel miggid hannashe shel behema temea, rabbi yehuda mechayyev shetayim, verabbi shimon poter.
Rabbi shimon hachi name deasar bahanaa, detanya: gid hannashe muttar bahanaa, divre rabbi yehuda, verabbi shimon oser.
Vahare dam, derachamana amar: "kol nefesh mikkem lo tochal dam", utenan: ellu vaellu mitarvin baamma, veyotzin lenachal kidron, venimkarin laggannanin lezabbel, umoalin bo!
Shane dam deittakkash lemayim, dichtiv "lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim" — ma mayim muttarin, af dam muttar.
Veema, kammayim hammitnassechim al gabbe hammizbeach! amar rabbi avahu "kammayim" — rov mayim. midde "rov mayim" ketiv?! ella amar rav ashe: kammayim hannishpachin, velo kammayim hannissachin.
Veema: kammayim hannishpachin lifne avoda zara! hatam name nissuch ikkeri, dichtiv "yishtu yen nesicham".
b: Ulechizkiyya, lemay hilcheta ittakkash dam lemayim? lechidrabbi chiyyay bar abba, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin ledam kadashim sheeno machshir — shenneemar "lo tochlennu al haaretz tishpechennu kammayim", dam shennishpach kammayim — machshir, sheeno nishpach kammayim — eno machshir.

Vahare ever min hachay, dichtiv "lo tochal hannefesh im habbasar", vetanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin shello yoshit adam kos yayin lenazir veever min hachay livne noach — talmud lomar "velifne ivver lo titten michshol", ha lichlavim — shere!
Shane ever min hachay deittakkash ledam, dichtiv: "rak chazak levilti achol haddam ki haddam hu hannafesh".

Ulechizkiyya, lemay hilcheta ittakkash ever min hachay ledam? amar lach, dam hu deittakkash leever min hachay: ma ever min hachay asur — af dam min hachay asur. vei ze — ze dam hakkaza, shehannefesh yotza bo.

Vahare shor hanniskal, derachamana amar: "lo yeachel et besaro", vetanya: mimmashma shenneemar "sakol yissakel hashshor" eni yodea shehi nevela, unevela asura baachila?! uma talmud lomar "lo yeachel"? maggid lecha hakkatuv sheim shechato leachar shennigmar (et) dino — asur.
En li ella baachila, bahanaa minnayin? talmud lomar "uvaal hashshor naki". may mashma? shimon ben zoma omer: keadam sheomer lachavero "yatza peloni naki minnechasav", veen lo bahem hanaa shel kelum.
Tama dichtav "uvaal hashshor naki", dei millo yeachel", issur achila — mashma, issur hanaa — la mashma!

Leolam "lo yeachel" issur achila veissur hanaa mashma, "uvaal hashshor naki" lahanaat oro hu daata. veitzterich, salka datach amena: "lo yeachel et besaro" ketiv: besaro — in, oro — la, ka mashma lan.
Ulehanach tannae demappeki leh lehay kera lidrasha acharina, lachatzi kofer velidme vevladot, hanaat oro mena lehu? nafka lehu meet besaro" — et hattafel livsaro.
Veiddach? "et" la daresh.

Kidtanya: shimon haamsoni, veamri la nechemya haamsoni, haya doresh kol 'ettim shebbattora, kevan shehiggia leet Adonai elohecha tira" perash. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, kol 'ettim sheddarashta ma tehe alehen? amar lahem: keshem shekkibbalti sachar al hadderisha, kach ani mekabbel sachar al happerisha. ad shebba rabbi akiva vedarash: "et Adonai elohecha tira" — lerabbot talmide chachamim.

Vahare orla, derachamana amar: "arelim lo yeachel", vetanya: "arelim lo yeachel", en li ella issur achila. minnayin shello yehane mimmennu, shello yitzba bo, velo yadlik bo et hanner? talmud lomar: "vaaraltem orlato ... arelim lo yeachel" — lerabbot et kullam.
Tama dichtav rachamana "vaaraltem orlato ... arelim", ha lav hachi, hava amena: issur achila — mashma, issur hanaa — la mashma!
Leolam "lo yeachel" mashma ben issur achila ben issur hanaa, veshane hatam dichtiv "lachem". veitzterich, salka datach amena: hoil uchetav "lachem" — shellachem yehe, kamashma lan.
Veella hasheta dichtivi hanach kerae, "lachem" lema li? lechidtanya: "lachem", lerabbot et hannatua

a: Lerabbim. rabbi yehuda omer: lehotzi et hannatua lerabbim.

May tama detanna kamma — dichtiv "unetatem", leyachid mashma, lerabbim la mashma. ketav rachamana "lachem" — lehavi et hannatua lerabbim. verabbi yehuda: "unetatem" mashma ben lerabbim ben leyachid, velachem" ben yachid ben rabbim mashma. have ribbuy achar ribbuy — veen ribbuy achar ribbuy ella lemaet.
Vahare teruma, derachamana amar: "vechol zar lo yochal kodesh", utenan: mearvin lenazir beyayin, uleyisrael bitruma!
Amar rav pappa: shane hatam deamar kera "terumatchem" — shellachem tehe. veiddach? "terumatchem" — dechol yisrael kaamar.
Vahare nazir, derachamana amar: "mechartzannim vead zag lo yochel", utenan: mearvin lannazir beyayin. amar mar zutera: shane hatam, deamar kera "nizro" — shello yehe.
Rav ashe amar: "kadosh yihye gaddel pera sear rosho", giddulo kadosh, veen davar acher kadosh. midde "veen davar acher" ketiv?! ella mechavvavrta kidmar zutera.
Vahare chadash, derachamana amar: "lechem vekali vecharmel lo tochlu ad etzem hayyom hazze", utenan: kotzer leshachat, umaachil labbehema!
Amar rav shemaya: shane hatam deamar kera: "ketzirchem" — ketzirchem shellachem yehe. veiddach? "ketzirchem" — dechol yisrael mashma.

Vahare sheratzim, derachamana amar: "sheketz hu lo yeachel", utenan: tzayyayde chayya veofot vedagim shennizdammenu lahem minin temein — muttarin lemochran legoyim. shane hatam, deamar kera: "lachem" — shellachem yehe.
I hachi, afillu lechattechilla name! shane hacha, deamar kera: "yihyu" — bahavayaytan yehu.
Ulechizkiyya, lema li lemichtav "lo yeachel", umayyte "lachem" lemishreyeh? la lichtov rachamana "lo yeachel", vela bae "lachem"! amar lach chizkiyya, tama didi name mehacha.

Vahare chametz, derachamana amar: "lo yeachel chametz", vetanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: tema al atzmecha heach chametz asur bahanaa kol shiva? shane hatam, deamar kera: "velo yerae lecha seor" — shellecha yehe.
Verabbanan? shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah. veiddach? tere "lecha" ketivi.
Veiddach? chad — begoy shekkibbashto, vechad — begoy shello kibbashto. veiddach? telata "lecha" ketivi. veiddach? chad — bisor, vechad — bechametz. utzerichi.

Lema ketannae. "yease lechol melacha", ma talmud lomar: "lechol melacha", sheyyachol limlechet gavoah yehe muttar, limlechet hedyot yehe asur, talmud lomar: "lechol melacha" — divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Rabbi akiva omer: sheyyachol limlechet hedyot yehe tahor, limlechet gavoah yehe tame, talmud lomar: "lechol melacha".
Verabbi yose haggelili, letumea uletohora la itzterich kera. ki itzterich kera — leissur ulehetter. verabbi akiva, issur vehetter la tzerich kera, ki itzterich kera — letumea uletohora.
b: May lav beha kamippalgi, derabbi yose haggelili savar: "lo tochlu" mashma ben issur achila ben issur hanaa, vechi ata kera lemishreyay linvela — bahanaa hu daata. verabbi akiva savar: issur achila — mashma, issur hanaa la mashma. vechi ata kera — letumea vetohora.

La, dechulle alma "lo tochlu" mashma ben issur achila ben issur hanaa. vehacha beha kamippalgi, rabbi yose haggelili savar: keshehuttera nevela — hi huttera, chelbah vegidah — lo hutteru. vechi itzterich kera — lehetter hanaa hu daata. verabbi akiva savar: keshehuttera nevela — chelbah vegidah name hutteru. vechi itzterich kera — letumea vetohora.

Verabbi yose haggelili, ashkechan chelev desharyeh rachamana bahanaa, ella gid nema deasur! ibbaet ema: hachi name deasur. ibbaet ema, mayyte la bekal vachomer: uma chelev sheanush karet — muttar bahanaa, gid sheeno anush karet — lo kol shekken.
Verabbi shimon deasar? ikka lemifrach, ma lechelev shekken huttar mikkelalo etzel chayya, tomar begid shello huttar mikkelalo etzel chayya.
Veiddach? bivhema kaamrinan — bivhema mihat la ishteri.

Mikkede otvinhu kol hane kerae veshanninhu. chizkiyya verabbi avahu bemay peligi! bechametz bappesach veallibba derabbanan, beshor hanniskal veallibba dedivre hakkol. chizkiyya nafek leh millo yeachel", verabbi avahu nafek leh minnevela.
Mikkedi ben lemar uven lemar asurin bahanaa, may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu chullin shennishchatu baazara. chizkiyya savar: "lo yeachel" — lemaote hane, "oto" — lemaote chullin shennishchatu baazara.
Rabbi avahu savar: "oto" — lemaote hane, chullin shennishchatu baazara lav deorayyta ninhu.

Yatev hahu merabbanan kammeh derabbi shemuel bar nachmani, veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin lechol issurin shebbattora dechi hechi daasurin baachila hachi name asurin bahanaa? umay nihu — chametz bappesach veshor hanniskal. minnayin?! tippok leh millo yeachel"! "lo yeachel", issur achila — mashma leh, issur hanaa — la mashma leh.
Tippok leh minnevela?! savar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: devarim kichtavan.
I savar la kerabbi yehuda, tippok leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi yehuda, millakkelev tashlichun oto"!
Kasavar: chullin shennishchatu baazara deorayyta. minnayin, dichtiv: "kol chattat asher yuva middamah vegomer".
Sheen talmud lomar "baesh tissaref", uma talmud lomar "baesh tissaref"? im eno inyan legufo, dichtiv "vehinne soraf", tenehu inyan lechol issurin shebbattora.

a: Veim eno inyan laachila, tenehu inyan leissur hanaa.
I, ma kan bisrefa — af kol issurin shebbattora bisrefa! amar kera "bakkodesh ... baesh tissaref", bakkodesh — bisrefa, veen kol issurin shebbattora bisrefa.

Vehay "bakkodesh ... baesh tissaref" lehachi hu daata?! hay mibbee leh lechidrabbi shimon! detanya, rabbi shimon omer: "bakkodesh ... baesh tissaref" — limmed al chattat shessorfin otah bakkodesh. veen li ella zo bilvad, pesule kodshe kadashim veemure kadashim kallim minnayin? talmud lomar: "(vechol) bakkodesh ... baesh tissaref".

Amar leh, rabbi yonatan rabbach mehay kera kaamar la: "veim yivvater mibbesar hammilluim umin hallechem ad habboker vegomer", sheen talmud lomar "lo yeachel", uma talmud lomar "lo yeachel" — im eno inyan legufeh, deha ketiv "vesarafta et hannotar baesh", tenehu inyan lishar issurin shebbattora. veim eno inyan laachila, tenehu inyan leissur hanaa.
I, ma kan bisrefa, af kol issurin shebbattora bisrefa! amar kera "vesarafta et hannotar" — notar bisrefa, veen kol issurin shebbattora bisrefa.
Vehay "lo yeachel" lehachi hu daata? hay mibbee leh lechidrabbi elazar. deamar rabbi elazar: "lo yeachel ki kodesh hu" — kol shebbakkodesh pasul, ba hakkatuv litten lo taase al achilato.

Amar abbaye: leolam mikra kamma, veefoch: delichtov "baesh tissaref", vela bae "lo teachel", ma talmud lomar "lo teachel" — im eno inyan legufo, denafka leh midderabbi elazar, tenehu inyan lechol issurin shebbattora. veim eno inyan laachila, tenehu inyan leissur hanaa.
I ma kan bisrefa, af kol issurin shebbattora bisrefa. amar kera "hannotar" — hannotar bisrefa, veen kol issurin shebbattora bisrefa.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: veema leyachode leh lav legufeh hu daata, dei midderabbi elazar — en lokin al lav shebbichlalot.
Ella amar rav pappa, mehacha: "vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel baesh yissaref", sheen talmud lomar "lo yeachel", ma talmud lomar "lo yeachel"?
Im eno inyan legufo, deha nafka leh mikkal vachomer mimmaaser hakkal: uma maaser hakkal, amra tora "lo viarti mimmennu betame" — besar kodesh chamur lo kol shekken?!
Vechi tema "en mazhirin min haddin". hekkesha hu, dichtiv: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vegomer" —
Ma talmud lomar "lo yeachel"? im eno inyan legufo, tenehu inyan lechol issurin shebbattora. veim eno inyan laachila, tenehu inyan lahanaa.
I, ma kan bisrefa — af kol issurin shebbattora bisrefa! amar kera "hannotar" — hannotar bisrefa, veen kol issurin shebbattora bisrefa.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: veema, laavor alav bishne lavin. lav mi amar abbaye: achal putita — loke arba.
Nemala — loke chamesh.
b: Tzira — loke shesh! amar leh: kol hecha deikka lemidrash — darshinan, vela mokminan belave yattire.
"Vehabbasar asher yigga bechol tame lo yeachel" deresheh lema li? lerabbot etzim ulevona. "vehabbasar kol tahor yochal basar" desefeh lema li? lerabbot emurin.
Emurin mehatam nafka, detanya: "vehannefesh asher tochal basar mizzevach hashshelamim asher laAdonai" — lerabbot et haemurin!
Hatam tumeat hagguf — becharet, hacha tumeat basar — belav.
Amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kol issurin shebbattora en lokin alehen ella derech achilatan. lemaote may? amar rav shimi bar ashe: lemaote sheim achal chelev chay, sheppatur.

Ikka deamri, amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kol issurin shebbattora en lokin alehen ella derech hanaatan. lemaote may? amar rav shimi bar ashe: lemaote sheim hinniach chelev shel shor hanniskal al gabbe makkato, shehu patur. vechol shekken ochel chelev chay, shehu patur.

Ittemar name, amar rav acha bar avya amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: hinniach chelev shel shor hanniskal al gabbe makkato — patur, lefi shekkol issurin shebbattora en lokin alehem ella derech hanaatan.

Amar rabbi zera, af anan name tenena: en sofgin et haarbaim mishshum orla, ella al hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim bilvad. veillu mittutim teenim verimmonim — la. may tama — lav mishshum dela kaachel lehu derech hanaatan?!
Amar leh abbaye: bishlama i ashmeinan peri gufa dela kaachel leh derech hanaato — shappir, ella hacha, mishshum dezea bealma hu.
Amar abbaye: hakkol modim bechile hakkerem shellokin alehen afillu shello kederech hanaatan, may tama — mishshum dela ketiv behu achila.
Metivi, isi ben yehuda omer: minnayin levasar bechalav shehu asur? neemar kan "ki am kadosh atta", veneemar lehallan "veanshe kodesh tihyun li". ma lehallan asur, af kan asur.
Veen li ella baachila, bahanaa minnayin? amarta, kal vachomer: uma orla shello neevda bah avera, asura bahanaa. basar bechalav shenneevda bo avera, eno din sheyyehe asur bahanaa?

a: Ma leorla shekken lo hayta lah sheat hakkosher — tomar bevasar bechalav shehayta lo sheat hakkosher! chametz bappesach yochiach — shehaya lo sheat hakkosher, veasur bahanaa.
Ma lechametz bappesach — shekken anush karet, tomar bevasar bechalav sheeno anush karet! kile hakkerem yochichu, sheen anush karet — veasur bahanaa.
Veim ita, nifroch: ma lechile hakkerem — shekken lokin alehen afillu shello kederech hanaatan.
Veabbaye, "tomar" bemay?! tomar bevasar bechalav sheen lokin alav ella derech hanaato — attu bevasar bechalav achila ketiva beh?!
Veiddach deka motev la! savar, lehachi ka gamar minnevela. ma nevela derech hanaatah — af basar bechalav derech hanaato.
Veabbaye: lehachi lo katav achila begufo, lomar shellokin alav afillu shello kederech hanaato.
Velifroch: ma lechile hakkerem shekken lo hayta lo sheat hakkosher! amar rabbi adda bar ahava: zot omeret kile hakkerem ikkaran neesarin, hoil vehayta lahen sheat hakkosher kodem hasherasha.
Metiv rav shemaya: hammaavir atzitz nakuv bakkerem, im hosif matayim — asur. hosif in, lo hosif la!
Amar rava, tere kerae ketivi: ketiv "hazzara" uchetiv "hammelea", ha ketzad? zarua meikkaro — behasherasha. zarua uva, hosif — in, lo hosif — la.

Amar rabbi yaakov amar rabbi yochanan: bakkol mitrappein, chutz meatze ashera. hechi dame? i nema deikka sakkana — afillu atze ashera name! vei delekka sakkana — afillu kol issurin shebbattora name la?!

Leolam deikka sakkana, vaafillu hachi atze ashera la. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: im neemar "bechol nafshecha", lamma neemar "bechol meodecha". veim neemar "bechol meodecha", lamma neemar "bechol nafshecha"?
Ella lomar lach: im yesh adam sheggufo chaviv alav mimmamono — lechach neemar "bechol nafshecha". veyesh adam shemmamono chaviv alav miggufo — lechach neemar "bechol meodecha".
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: bakkol mitrappein, chutz meavoda zara vegilluy arayot
b: Ushefichut damim.
Avoda zara — ha daamaran. gilluy arayot ushefichut damim, detanya, rabbi omer: "ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu uretzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze". vechi ma inyan rotzeach etzel naara hameorasa?

Hare ze ba lelammed, venimtza lamed. makkish rotzeach lenaara hameorasa: ma naara hameorasa — nittan lehatztzilah benafsho, af rotzeach — nittan lehatztzilo benafsho. venaara hameorasa merotzeach: ma rotzeach — yehareg veal yaavor, af naara hameorasa — tehareg veal taavor.

Ushefichut damim gufeh menalan? sevara hu: ki hahu daata lekammeh derava, amar leh: mare duray amar li: zil katleh liflanya, vei la — katlina lach. amar leh: likteluch vela tiktol, may chazet didma didach summak tefe? dilma dema dehahu gavra summak tefe.
Mar bar rav ashe ashkecheh leravina deshayef la livratteh beguharke deorla. amar leh: emor daamur rabbanan bishat hassakkana, shello bishat hassakkana mi amur?
Amar leh: hay ishshata tzemirta name kishat hassakkana damya. ikka deamri, amar leh: midde derech hanaa ka avedna?
Ittemar: hanaa habbaa lo leadam beal korcho, abbaye amar: mutteret, verava amar: asura.
Efshar veka mikkavven, la efshar vekamikkaven — kulle alma la peligi deasur. la efshar vela mikkavven — kulle alma la peligi dishre. ki peligi deefshar vela mikkavven.

Veallibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven asur — kulle alma la peligi deasur. ki peligi allibba derabbi shimon, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven muttar. abbaye kerabbi shimon, verava amar: ad kan la ka amar rabbi shimon — ella hecha dela efshar, aval hecha deefshar — la.

Ikka deamri: efshar vela mikkavven — hayeynu pelugetayyhu derabbi yehuda verabbi shimon. la efshar vela ka mikkavven — kulle alma la peligi dishre. ki peligi, dela efshar veka mikkavven. veallibba derabbi shimon deazel batar kauona — kulle alma la peligi deasur, ki peligi allibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: la shena mitkavven vela shena sheen mitkavven, efshar asur.
Abbaye kerabbi yehuda.

a: Verava amar lach: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda sheen mitkavven kemitkavven — ella lechumera, aval mitkavven kesheen mitkavven lekulla — la.
Amar abbaye: mena amena la — detanya: amru alav al rabban yochanan ben zakkay shehaya yoshev betzillo shel hechol, vedoresh kol hayyom kullo. veha hacha dela efshar umikkaven, veshare.
Verava amar: shane hechol diltocho asuy.

Amar rava: mena amena la, (detanya) lulin hayu petuchin baaliyyayt bet kodshe hakkodashim, shebbahen meshalshelin et haummanim betevot kede shello yazunu enehem mibbet kodshe hakkodashim. veha hacha dela efshar veka mikkavven — veasur.
Vetisbera?! vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol umare vareach en bahen mishshum meila! ella, maala asu bevet kodshe hakkodashim.

Ikka deamri, amar rava: mena amena la? detanya: amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol umare vareach en bahen mishshum meila. meila — hu delekka, ha issura — ikka.
May lav, leotan haomdin bifnim, dela efshar veka mikkavven — veasur! la, leotan haomdin bachutz.

Gufa. amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol umare vareach en bahen mishshum meila. vereach en bo mishshum meila? veha tanya: hamefattem et hakketoret lehitlammed bah, o lemosrah latztzibbur — patur. lehariach bah — chayyayv. vehammeriach bah — patur, ella shemmaal!
Ella amar rav pappa: kol umare en bahen mishshum meila, lefi sheen bahen mammash. vereach leachar shettaale timroto — en bo mishshum meila, hoil venaaset mitzvato.

Lememra dechol hecha denaaset mitzvato en bo mishshum meila?! vahare terumat haddeshen, denaaset mitzvatah — veyesh bah mishshum meila. dichtiv: "vesamo etzel hammizbeach" — shello yefazzer, "vesamo" — shello yehane.
Mishshum dehavu terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Terumat haddeshen — ha daamaran. bigde chehunna, dichtiv: "vehinnicham sham" — melammed shetteunin geniza.

Hanicha lerabbanan deamri melammed shetteunin geniza, ella lerabbi dosa diflig alayyhu, deamar: aval reuyin hen lechohen hedyot, umay "vehinnicham sham" — shello yishtammesh bahem beyom kippurim acher, may ikka lememar?
Mishshum dehavu terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin — may ikka lememar? tere miute ketivi: ketiv "vesamo", uchetiv "haarufa".
Ta shema: hichnisa lerivka vedasha — keshera. bishvil shettinak vetadush — pesula.
Veha hacha dela efshar veka mikkavven, vekatane pesula! shane hatam, dichtiv: "asher lo ubbad bah", mikkol makom.
I hachi afillu resha name!
b: Ha la damya ella leha: shachan aleha of — keshera, ala aleha zachar — pesula. may tama?
Amar rav pappa: i ketiv "avad" vekarenan "avad" — ad deaved bah ihu. i ketiv "ubbad" vekarenan "ubbad" — afillu mimmela name.
Hasheta dichtiv "avad" vekarenan "ubbad" — ubbad dumeya deavad. ma avad denicha leh, af ubbad denicha leh.

Ta shema: aveda, lo yishtachenna lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe maggod letzorko, aval shotchah letzorkah al gabbe mitta veal gabbe maggod. nizdammenu lo orchin, lo yishtachenna lo al gabbe mitta velo al gabbe maggod, ben letzorkah ben letzorko.
Shane hatam dekale la, i mishshum ena bisha, i mishshum gannave.
Ta shema: mochre chesut mochrin kedarkan, uvilvad shello yitkavven bachamma mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. vehatztzenuin mafshilin laachorehem bemakkel.
Veha hacha deefshar lemebad kitznuin, vechi la mechavven — shere. teyuveta leman dematne lishshana kamma derava, teyuveta.
Velo yassik bo vechulei. tanu rabbanan: tannur shehissiko biklippe orla o bekashshin shel kile hakkerem, chadash — yuttatz, yashan — yutzan.
Afa bo et happat, rabbi omer: happat asura, vachachamim omrim: happat mutteret. bishshelah al gabbe gechalim — divre hakkol muttar.
Veha tanya: ben chadash uven yashan yutzan! la kashya: ha — rabbi, veha — rabbanan.
Emor deshamat leh lerabbi mishshum deyesh shevach etzim bappat. ze vaze gorem mi shamat leh? ella, la kashya: ha — rabbi eliezer, ha — rabbanan.

He rabbi eliezer? ilema rabbi eliezer disor, ditnan: seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch issa, veen baze kede lehachemitz veen baze kede lehachemitz, venitztarfu vechimmetzu — rabbi eliezer omer: achar acharon ani ba, vachachamim omrim: ben shennafal issur lechattechilla, uven shennafal issur levassof — leolam eno oser

a: Ad sheyyehe bo kede lehachemitz. veamar abbaye: lo shanu ella shekkadam vesillek et haissur, aval lo kadam vesillek et haissur — asur, alma ze veze gorem asur.

Umimmay detama derabbi eliezer keabbaye? dilma tama derabbi eliezer mishshum deachar acharon ani ba — la shena kadam vesillek et haissur, la shena lo kadam vesillek et haissur. aval bevat achat, hachi name dishre!
Ella rabbi eliezer daatze ashera, ditnan: natal hemenna etzim — asurin bahanaa. hissik bahen et hattannur, chadash — yuttatz, yashan — yutzan.
Afa bo et happat — asurin bahanaa. nitarva beacharot vaacherot baacherot — kullan asurin bahanaa. rabbi eliezer omer: yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. (amar) lo: en pidyon laavoda zara.

Emor deshamat leh lerabbi eliezer baavoda zara — dachamir issura, bishar issurin shebbattora mi shamat leh? ella im ken, amman tirmeyay? veod, ha tanya behedya: vechen haya rabbi eliezer oser bechol issurin shebbattora.

Amar abbaye: im timtza lomar "ze vaze gorem asur" — rabbi hayeynu rabbi eliezer, veim timtze lomar "ze vaze gorem muttar", vehacha mishshum deyesh shevach etzim befat hu — hane kearot vechosot utzelochiyyot asiri.
Ki peligi betannur ukedera: leman deamar "ze vaze gorem asur" — asur. leman deamar "ze vaze gorem muttar" — shere.
Ikka deamri: afillu leman deamar "ze vaze gorem muttar", kedera — asura, deha kabbela bishshula mikkamme denitten etzim dehettera.

Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: tannur shehissiko biklippe orla, o bekashshin shel kile hakkerem, chadash — yuttatz, yashan — yutzan. afa bo et happat, rabbi omer: happat mutteret, vachachamim omrim: happat asura. vehatanya ippecha! shemuel ippecha tane.
Veibbaet ema: bealma kasavar shemuel halacha kerabbi mechavero velo mechaverav, uveha — afillu mechaverav. vesavar atneyay ippecha, ki hechi denekum rabbanan leissura.

Bishshelah al gabbe gechalim — divre hakkol happat mutteret. (amar) rav yehuda amar shemuel, verabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rabbi yochanan, chad amar: lo shanu ella gechalim ommot, aval gechalim lochashot — asurin, vechad amar: afillu gechalim lochashot name muttarin.

Bishlama leman deamar lochashot asurin, mishshum deyesh shevach etzim bappat. ella leman deamar afillu lochashot muttarot, pat deasar deyesh shevach etzim bappat lerabbi hechi mashkachat leh? amar rav pappa: kesheavuka kenegdo.
b: Mikkelal derabbanan difligi aleh — sharu afillu kesheavuka kenegdo, ella etzim deissura lerabbanan hechi mashkachat lehu? amar rav amme bar chama: besharshifa.

Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: tannur shehissiko baatze hekdesh, veafa bo happat, lerabbanan desharu bekammayyta, may? amar leh: happat asura. uma ben zo leorla?! amar rava: hachi hasheta?! orla betela bematayim, hekdesh afillu beelef lo batel.
Ella amar rava: i kashya leh — ha kashya: vahalo maal hammassik, vechol hecha demaal hammassik nafku lehu lechullin!
Amar rav pappa: hacha baatze shelamim askinan, veallibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: hekdesh beshogeg mitchallel, bemezid eno mitchallel.
Bemezid may tama la? kevan delav bar meila — hu la nafek lechullin. shelamim name, kevan delav bar meila ninhu — la nafka lechullin.
Vechol hecha demaal hammassik nafki lechullin? veha tanya: kol hannisrafin — efran muttar, chutz meatze ashera. veefer hekdesh — leolam asur.

Amar rame bar chama: kegon shennafla deleka meeleha baatze hekdesh, delekka inash denimol. rav shemaya amar: beotan shetteunin geniza. detanya: "vesamo" benachat, "vesamo" kullo, "vesamo" shello yefazzer.

Rabbi yehuda omer en biur vechulei. tanya, amar rabbi yehuda: en biur chametz ella serefa, vehaddin noten: uma notar sheeno beval yerae" uval yimmatze" — taun serefa, chametz sheyyeshno beval yerae" uval yimmatze" — lo kol shekken shettaun serefa!

Amru lo: kol din sheatta dan techillato lehachemir vesofo lehakel eno din. lo matza etzim lesorfo yehe yoshev uvatel? vehattora amra: "tashbitu seor mibbattechem", bechol davar sheatta yachol lehashebito!
Chazar rabbi yehuda vedano din acher: notar asur baachila vechametz asur baachila. ma notar bisrefa — af chametz bisrefa.
Amru lo: nevela tochiach, sheasura baachila veenah teuna serefa! amar lahen, hefresh: notar asur baachila uvahanaa, vechametz asur baachila uvahanaa. ma notar taun serefa — af chametz taun serefa.

Amru lo: shor hanniskal yochiach, sheasur baachila uvahanaa — veeno taun serefa. amar lahen, hefresh: notar asur baachila uvahanaa veanush karet, vechametz asur baachila uvahanaa veanush karet, ma notar bisrefa — af chametz bisrefa. amru lo: chelbo shel shor hanniskal yochiach, sheasur baachila uvahanaa veanush karet — veen taun serefa!

a: Chazar rabbi yehuda vedano din acher: notar yeshno beval totiru", vechametz beval totiru". ma notar bisrefa — af chametz bisrefa.
Amru lo: asham taluy vechattat haof habba al hassafek lidvarecha yochichu, shehen beval totiru". sheanu omrim bisrefa, veatta omer bikvura! shatak rabbi yehuda.
Amar rav yosef, hayeynu deamri inashe: kappa dachata naggara — begavvav nisrof chardela.
(Amar abbaye:) saddana besaddane yetev — middevil yedeh mishtallem.
Rava amar: giraa begireh mikketil — middevil yedeh mishtallem.

Vachachamim omrim mefarer vezore vechulei. ibbaya lehu, hechi kaamar: mefarer vezore laruach, umefarer umetil layyam. o dilma: mefarer vezore laruach, aval metil layyam beeneh. tenan name gabbe avoda zara ki hay gavvna, rabbi yose omer: shochek vezore laruach, o metil layyam. veibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar? shochek vezore laruach, veshochek umetil layyam. o dilma shochek vezore laruach, aval metil layyam beeneh.

Amar rabba: mistabbera avoda zara dilyam hammelach ka azla — la bae shechika. chametz delishar neharot kaazel — bae perur. amar leh rav yosef: adderabba, ippecha mistabbera: avoda zara dela mimmissa — bae shechika. chametz demimmis — la bae perur.

Tanya kevoteh derabba, tanya kevoteh derav yosef. tanya kevoteh derabba: haya mehallech bammidbar — mefarer vezore laruach. haya mehallech bisfina — mefarer umetil layyam. tanya kevoteh derav yosef: haya mehallech bammidbar — shochek vezore laruach. haya mehallech bisfina — shochek umetil layyam.
Shechika kashya lerabba, perur kashya lerav yosef. shechika lerabba la kashya: ha — leyam hammelach, ha — lishar neharot. perur lerav yosef la kashya: ha — bechitte, ha — benahama.
Mishna chametz shel goy sheavar alav happesach — muttar bahanaa, veshel yisrael — asur bahanaa, shenneemar: "lo yerae lecha seor".

Gemara manni matnitin? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi shimon vela rabbi yose haggelili. may hi? detanya: chametz, ben lifne zemanno ben leachar zemanno — over alav belav. toch zemanno — over alav belav vecharet, divre rabbi yehuda.
b: Rabbi shimon omer: chametz lifne zemanno uleachar zemanno — eno over alav belo kelum. toch zemanno — over alav becharet uvelav. umishshaa sheasur baachila asur bahanaa, atan letanna kamma. rabbi yose haggelili omer: tema al atzmecha, heach chametz asur bahanaa kol shiva!
Uminnayin laochel chametz mishshesh shaot ulemala shehu over belo taase — shenneemar: "lo tochal alav chametz", divre rabbi yehuda.

Amar lo rabbi shimon: vechi efshar lomar ken? vahalo kevar neemar "lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot"! im ken, ma talmud lomar "lo tochal alav chametz"? beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol matztza — yeshno beval tochal chametz, uveshaa sheeno bekum echol matztza — eno beval tochal chametz.
May tama derabbi yehuda? telata kerae ketivi: "lo yeachel chametz", "vechol machmetzet lo tochelu", "lo tochal alav chametz". chad lifne zemanno, vechad leachar zemanno, vechad letoch zemanno.
Verabbi shimon: chad letoch zemanno. "vechol machmetzet" mibbee leh lechidtanya: en li ella shennitchammetz meelav. mechamat davar acher minnayin? talmud lomar: "kol machmetzet lo tochelu".

"Lo yeachel chametz" mibbee leh lechidtanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: minnayin lefesach mitzrayim sheen chimmutzo noheg ella yom echad? talmud lomar: "lo yeachel chametz", usemich leh: "hayyom attem yotzim".
Verabbi yehuda, mechamat davar acher mena leh? middeappekeh rachamana bilshon machmetzet.
Derabbi yose haggelili mena leh? i baet ema: middismich leh "hayyom". i baet ema: semuchin la daresh.

Amar mar: uminnayin leochel chametz mishshesh shaot ulemala shehu over belo taase, shenneemar: "lo tochal alav chametz", divre rabbi yehuda. amar lo rabbi shimon: vechi efshar lomar ken? vahalo kevar neemar "lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot".
Verabbi yehuda, shappir kaamar leh rabbi shimon? verabbi yehuda amar lach: hahu — lekovo chova afillu bazzeman hazze hu daata.

Verabbi shimon, lekovo chova mena leh? nafka leh mibbaerev tochlu". verabbi yehuda, mibbee leh letame veshehaya bederech rechoka. salka datach amena: hoil uvefesach lo yochal — matztza umaror name la nechol. ka mashma lan.

Verabbi shimon, tame veshehaya bederech rechoka la itzterich kera, dela gara mearel uven nechar. dichtiv: "vechol arel lo yochal bo" — bo hu eno ochel, aval ochel hu bematztza uvemaror. verabbi yehuda: ketiv behay uchetiv behay.
Manni matnitin? i rabbi yehuda — chametz setama kaamar, afillu degoy. vei rabbi shimon —

a: Deyisrael name mishre ka share! vei rabbi yose haggelili — afillu toch zemanno name mishre ka share bahanaa.

Amar rav acha bar yaakov: leolam rabbi yehuda hi, veyalef seor daachila misseor diriyyay. ma seor diriyyay — shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah. af seor daachila — shellecha i atta ochel, aval atta ochel shel acherim veshel gavoah.

Uvedin hu deibbei leh lemitne daafillu baachila name shere, veayyeyde ditna deyisrael asur bahanaa — tena name degoy muttar bahanaa. uvedin hu deibbei leh lemitne daafillu betoch zemanno muttar bahanaa, veayyeyde ditna deyisrael leachar zemanno — tena name degoy leachar zemanno.
Rava amar: leolam rabbi shimon hi. verabbi shimon, kenasa kanes, hoil veavar aleh beval yerae uval yimmatze.
Bishlama lerava, hayeynu dekatane: shel yisrael asur, mishshum shenneemar "lo yerae". ella lerav acha bar yaakov, mishshum "lo yeachel chametz" mibbee leh!

Mi savrat assefa kae?! aresha kae vehachi kaamar: chametz shel goy sheavar alav happesach muttar bahanaa, mishshum shenneemar "lo yerae lecha" — shellecha i atta roe, aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah. veyalef seor daachila misseor diriyyay.
Veazdu letamayyhu: deittemar, haochel seor shel goy sheavar alav happesach, ledivre rabbi yehuda, rava amar: loke, verav acha bar yaakov amar: eno loke.
Rava amar: loke, la yalef rabbi yehuda seor daachila misseor diriyyay. verav acha bar yaakov amar: eno loke, yalef seor daachila misseor diriyyay.
Vahadar beh rav acha bar yaakov mehahi, detanya: haochel chametz shel hekdesh bammoed — maal. veyesh omrim: lo maal.
Man yesh omrim? amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana hi. detanya: rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana haya ose et yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin.
Ma shabbat mitchayyev benafsho ufatur min hattashlumin, af yom hakkippurim mitchayyev benafsho ufatur mittashlumin.
Rav yosef amar: befodin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim kamippalgi.
Man deamar maal, kasavar: podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim. uman deamar lo maal, kasavar: en podin.
Rav acha bar rava tena lah
b: Leha shemata mishshemeh derav yosef beha lishshana: dechulle alma en podin et hakkodashim lehaachilan lichlavim, vehacha beha kamippalgi: bedavar haggorem lemamon kemamon dame.
Man deamar maal, kasavar: davar haggorem lemamon — kemamon dame. uman deamar lo maal, kasavar: davar haggorem lemamon — lav kemamon dame.

Rav acha bar yaakov amar: dechulle alma davar haggorem lemamon — kemamon dame, vehacha biflugeta derabbi yehuda verabbi shimon kamippalgi: man deamar lo maal — kerabbi yehuda. uman deamar maal — kerabbi shimon.
Veha rav acha bar yaakov hu deamar derabbi yehuda yalef seor daachila misseor diriyyay! ella hadar beh rav acha bar yaakov mehahi.

Rav ashe amar: dechulle alma — en podin, vedavar haggorem lemamon — lav kemamon dame, vehacha biflugeta derabbi yose haggelili verabbanan kamippalgi. man deamar maal — kerabbi yose. uman deamar lo maal — kerabbanan.
Amar rav: chametz bizmanno, ben bemino ben shello bemino — asur. shello bizmanno, bemino — asur, shello bemino — muttar.
Bemay askinan? ilema benoten taam, shello bizmanno shello bemino muttar? ha yehev tama!
Ella bemashshehu. chametz bizmanno, ben bemino ben shello bemino asur, rav letameh, derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kol issurin shebbattora, bemino — bemashshehu, shello bemino — benoten taam.
Rav gazar chametz bizmanno shello bemino attu mino. veshello bizmanno bemino — asur, kerabbi yehuda.
Veshello bemino — muttar, deshello bizmanno veshello bemino attu mino — kulle hay la gazrinan.

Shemuel amar: chametz bizmanno, bemino — asur, shello bemino — muttar. shello bizmanno, ben bemino ben shello bemino — muttar. chametz bizmanno, bemino — asur, shemuel letameh — derav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kol issurin shebbattora, bemino — asurin bemashshehu, shello bemino — benoten taam.
Shello beminan attu minan la gazar. shello bizmanno, ben beminan ben shello beminan — muttarin, kerabbi shimon.
Verabbi yochanan amar: chametz bizmanno, ben bemino uven shello bemino — asur benoten taam. shello bizmanno, ben beminan ben shello beminan — muttar.

Chametz bizmanno, ben bemino ben shello bemino benoten taam — rabbi yochanan letameh, derabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: kol issurin shebbattora, ben beminan ben shello beminan — benoten taam. shello bizmanno, ben bemino ben shello bemino muttarin, kerabbi shimon.

a: Amar rava: hilcheta chametz bizmanno, ben bemino ben shello bemino — asur bemashshehu, kerav. shello bizmanno, ben bemino ben shello bemino — muttar, kerabbi shimon.
Umi amar rava hachi? vehaamar rava: rabbi shimon kenasa kanes, hoil veavar alav beval yerae" uval yimmatze"!
Hane mille beeneh, aval al yede taarovet — la. veazda rava letameh, deamar rava: ki havenan be rav nachman, ki havo nafki shiva yome defischa amar lan: puku uzevinu chamira divne chela.
Amar rav: kederot bappesach yishshavru. veammay? lashhinhu achar happesach, velebad behu shello beminan! gezera dilma atu lemebad behu bemino.
Ushemuel amar: lo yishshavru, aval mashhe lehu leachar zemanno, veaved behu ben bemino ben shello bemino.
Veazda shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel lehanhu dimzabbene kande: ashvo zevine akkandaychi, vei la — darshina lechu kerabbi shimon.
Velidrosh lehu, deha shemuel kerabbi shimon sevira leh! atreh derav hava.
Hahu tannura ditcho beh tichya. asre rava bar ahilay lemechleh lerifta afillu bemilcha leolam, dilma ate lemechleh bechuttacha.
Metivi: en lashin et haissa bechalav, veim lash — kol happat kullah asura, mippene hergel avera. kayyotze vo,
b: En tashin et hattannur bealya. veim tash — kol happat kullah asura, ad sheyyassik et hattannur. ha hussak hattannur — miha shere. teyuveta derava bar ahilay, teyuveta.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vechi meachar deittotav rava bar ahilay, ammay kaamar rav: kederot bappesach yishshavru? amar leh: hatam tannur shel mattechet, hacha bikdera shel cheres.
Veibbaet ema ha veha beshel cheres. ze — hessekan mibbifnim, veze — hessekan mibbachutz. vechi tema: hachi name lebad leh hassaka mibbifnim — chayes aleh mishshum defaka.
Hilkach hay bucheya hesseko mibbachutz hu — veasur, vei malleyeh gumere — shappir dame.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hane sakkine befischa hechi avdinan lehu? amar leh: ledidi chadta ka avdinan. amar leh: tinach mar deefshar leh, dela efshar leh may? amar leh: ana, keen chadta kaamena: kattayyhu betina, ufarzelayyhu benura, vahadar meayyelna lekattayyhu berotchin. vehilcheta: idde veidde berotchin uvichli rishon.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: etz parur magilo berotchin uvichli rishon. kasavar: kevolo kach polto.

Beo minneh meammemar: hane mane dekuneya, mahu leishtammoshe behu befischa? yerukka la tibbee lach — devadday asiri. ki tibbee lach ukkame vechivvare, may? vehecha deit behu kartufane, la tibbee lach, devadday asiri. ki tibbee lach deshii, may?
Amar leh: chazena lehu demidayyeyte, alma bali, vaasiri. vehattora heida al keli cheres sheeno yotze mide dofyo leolam.

Umay shena leinyan yen nesech, dedaresh marimar: mane dekuneya, ben ukkame ben chivvare uven yerukke — shere? vechi tema: yen nesech — derabbanan, chametz — deorayyta, kol detakkun rabbanan — keen deorayyta takkun. amar leh: ze tashmisho al yede chammin, veze tashmisho al yede tzonen.

Amar rava bar abba amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar shemuel: kol hakkelim shennishtammeshu bahen chametz betzonen — mishtammesh bahen matztza, chutz min bet seor, hoil shechimmutzo kashe. amar rav ashe: uvet charoset — kevet seor shechimmutzo kashe dame.

Amar rava: hane aggane demachoza, hoil utediri lemelash behu chamira, umeshahu behu chamira — kevet seor shechimmutzo kashe dame. peshita? mahu detema: kevan dirvicha, shalet behu avvera vela bali, ka mashma lan.
Mishna goy shehilva et yisrael al chametzo, achar happesach — muttar bahanaa. veyisrael shehilva et goy al chametzo, achar happesach — asur bahanaa.
Gemara ittemar: baal chov, abbaye amar: lemafrea hu gove. verava amar: mikkan ulehabba hu gove. kol hecha deakdesh love vezabben love — kulle alma la peligi deate malve vetaref,

a: Veate malve ufarek. ditnan: mosif od dinar ufode et hannechasim haellu. ki peligi dezabben malve, vekaddesh malve.

Abbaye amar, lemafrea hu gove: kevan dimta zimneh vela pareh, iggallay milleta lemafrea demeikkara birshuteh hava kae, veshappir akdesh, veshappir zabben. verava amar, mikkan ulehabba hu gove: kevan deillu havo leh zuze, hava mesallek lehu bezuze — ishtechach dehashta ka kane.

Umi amar rava hachi? vehaamar rame bar chama: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachrayut uzekafan alav bemilve, umet reuven, vaata baal chov diruven vetaref leh mishshimon, vaata shimon ufayyeyseh bezuze —
Dina hu deatu bene reuven veamri leh leshimon: anan, mittaltele shevak avun gabbach, umittaltele deyatme levaal chov la mishtabedi.
Veamar rava: i pikkeach shimon — magbe lehu ara, vahadar gave la minnayyhu. deamar rav nachman: yetomim sheggavu karka bechovat avihem — baal chov chozer vegove otah mehen.

I amrat bishlama "lemafrea hu gove", ammetu lehachi chozer vegove otah mehen — dichman degavu mechayyim daavuhon dame. ella i amrat "mikkan ulehabba hu gove", ammay chozer vegove otah mehen? ha have keman dizven yatme nichse dame, veillu kane yatme nichse, mi ka mishtabedi levaal chov?

Shane hatam, deamar lehu: ki hechi demishtabadna leh laavuchon, mishtabadna name levaal chov daavuchon — midderabbi natan. detanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane vachavero bachavero, shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze? talmud lomar: "venatan laasher asham lo".
Tenan: goy shehilva et yisrael al chametzo — achar happesach muttar bahanaa. i amrat bishlama "lemafrea hu gove" — ammetu lehachi muttar bahanaa.
Ella i amrat "mikkan ulehabba hu gove", ammay muttar bahanaa? birshuta deyisrael hava kae! hacha bemay askinan — keshehirhino etzlo.

Lema ketannae: yisrael shehilva legoy al chametzo — leachar happesach eno over. mishshum rabbi meir amru: over. may lav, beha kamippalgi: demar savar lemafrea hu gove, umar savar mikkan ulehabba hu gove?

Vetisbera? ema sefa: aval goy shehilva leyisrael al chametzo — leachar happesach divre hakkol over. veha ippecha mibbee leh: leman deamar hatam "eno over" — hacha over. leman deamar hatam "over" — hacha eno over!
b: Ella hacha bemay askinan — kegon shehirhino etzlo, vekamippalgi bidrabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon? shenneemar: "ulecha tihye tzedaka". im eno kone mashkon — tzedaka minnayin? mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon.
Tanna kamma savar: hane mille yisrael miyyisrael hu, dekarena beh "ulecha tihye tzedaka", aval yisrael miggoy — la kane.

Verabbi meir savar, kal vachomer: yisrael miyyisrael kane, yisrael miggoy lo kol shekken?! aval goy shehilva et yisrael al chametzo — achar happesach divre hakkol over. hatam vadday goy miyyisrael la kane.

Tenan: goy shehilva yisrael al chametzo — achar happesach muttar bahanaa. nehi name dehirhino etzlo, ha amrat goy miyyisrael la kane? la kashya ha — deamar leh "meachshav", ha — dela amar leh "meachshav".

Vmna temra deshane leh ben hecha deamar "meachshav" uven hecha dela amar "meachshav", detanya: goy shehirhin pat pureni etzel yisrael — eno over, veim amar lo "higgaticha" — over. may shena resha umay shena sefa? ella lav, shema minna: shane hecha deamar leh "meachshav" lehecha dela amar leh "meachshav". shema minna.

Tanu rabbanan: chanut shel yisrael umelay shel yisrael, ufoale goyim nichnasin lesham — chametz shennimtza sham achar happesach asur bahanaa, veen tzarich lomar baachila. chanut shel goy umelay shel goy ufoale yisrael nichnasin veyotzin lesham — chametz shennimtza sham achar happesach muttar baachila, veen tzarich lomar bahanaa.
Mishna chametz shennafla alav mappolet hare hu kimvoar. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kol sheen hakkelev yachol lechappes acharav.
Gemara amar rav chisda: vetzarich sheyyevattel belibbo. tana: kamma chafisat hakkelev — shelosha tefachim.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe: ha deamar shemuel kesafim en lahem shemira ella bakkarka, mi baenan shelosha tefachim o la? amar leh hacha mishshum recha baenan shelosha tefachim. hatam mishshum ikkassoye meena hu, vela bae shelosha. vechamma? amar rafram bar pappa missichra: tefach.
Mishna haochel terumat chametz bappesach, beshogeg — meshallem keren vachomesh, bemezid — patur mittashlumin umiddeme etzim.
Gemara tenan hatam: haochel teruma beshogeg — meshallem keren vachomesh, echad haochel veechad hashshote

a: Veechad hassach, echad teruma temea veechad teruma tehora — meshallem chomesh vechumesha dechumesha.

Ibbaya lehu: keshehu meshallem, lefi midda meshallem o lefi damim meshallem? kol hecha demeikkara shavya arbea zuze ulevassof shavya zuza — la tibbee lach, devadday kidmeikkara meshallem lefi damim, dela gara miggazlan. ditnan: kol haggazlanin meshallemin kishat haggezela,
Ki tibbee lach demeikkara shavya zuza ulevassof shavya arbea, may? lefi midda meshallem, deamar leh: geriva achal — geriva meshallem. o dilma lefi damim meshallem: bezuza achal — bezuza meshallem.

Amar rav yosef, ta shema: achal gerogrot veshillem lo temarim tavo alav beracha. i amrat bishlama lefi midda meshallem — ammetu lehachi tavo alav beracha, deachel geriva digrogrot deshavya zuza, veka yahev geriva ditmarim deshavya arbea. ella i amrat lefi damim meshallem — ammay tavo alav beracha? bezuza achal — bezuza ka meshallem!
Amar abbaye: leolam lefi damim meshallem, veammay tavo alav beracha? daachal midde dela kafetz aleh zavoyneh, veka meshallem midde dekafetz aleh zavoyneh.

Tenan: haochel terumat chametz bappesach, beshogeg meshallem keren vachomesh. i amrat bishlama lefi midda meshallem — shappir. ella i amrat lefi damim meshallem, chametz bappesach bar damim hu? in, ha manni rabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar chametz bappesach muttar bahanaa.
I hachi, ema sefa: bemezid patur min hattashlumin umiddeme etzim, i rabbi yose haggelili, ammay patur min hattashlumin umiddeme etzim?!
Savar la kerabbi nechuneya ben hakkana. detanya: rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana haya ose et yom hakkippurim kashshabbat letashlumin vechulei.

Ketannae: haochel terumat chametz bappesach — patur min hattashlumin umiddeme etzim, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yochanan ben nuri mechayyev. amar lo rabbi akiva lerabbi yochanan ben nuri: vechi ma hanaa yesh lo bah? amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri lerabbi akiva: uma hanaa yesh laochel teruma temea bishar kol yemot hashshana, shemmeshallem!

Amar lo: lo! im amarta bitruma temea bishar yemot hashshana, sheaf al pi sheen lo bah hetter achila, yesh lo bah hetter hassaka, tomar baze — sheen lo bah lo hetter achila velo hetter hassaka! ha lema ze dome — litrumat tutim vaanavim shennitmea, sheen lo bah lo hetter achila velo hetter hassaka.
Bamme devarim amurim — bemafrish teruma vehechemitza, aval mafrish terumat chametz — divre hakkol enah kedosha.

Tanya iddach: "venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh" — davar harauy lihyot kodesh. perat laochel terumat chametz bappesach, sheppatur min hattashlumim umiddeme etzim, divre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov. verabbi elazar chassama mechayyev. amar lo rabbi eliezer ben yaakov lerabbi elazar chassama: vechi ma hanaa yesh lo bah? amar lo rabbi elazar chassama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov: vechi ma hanaa yesh lo laochel teruma temea bishar yemot hashshana, shemmeshallem?

Amar lo: lo! im amarta bitruma temea bishar yemot hashshana, sheaf al pi sheen lo bah hetter achila yesh lo bah hetter hassaka, tomar bazo — sheen lo bah lo hetter achila velo hetter hassaka! amar lo: af bezo yesh lo bah hetter hassaka, sheim ratza hakkohen — meritzah lifne kalbo, o massikah tachat tavshilo.
b: Amar abbaye: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov verabbi akiva verabbi yochanan ben nuri kullehu sevira lehu chametz bappesach asur bahanaa, uveha peligi, derabbi akiva savar: lefi damim meshallem, verabbi yochanan ben nuri savar: lefi midda meshallem.

Peshita! mahu detema: rabbi yochanan ben nuri name kerabbi akiva sevira leh, deamar lefi damim meshallem. vehatam hayeynu tama deka mechayyev — mishshum desavar la kerabbi yose haggelili, deamar: chametz bappesach muttar bahanaa, ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name? im ken, nahdar leh rabbi yochanan ben nuri lerabbi akiva ki hechi demahdar leh rabbi elazar chassama lerabbi eliezer ben yaakov.

Tanu rabbanan: haochel kezayit teruma meshallem keren vachomesh, abba shaul omer: ad sheyyehe bo shave peruta. may tama detanna kamma — amar kera: "veish ki yochal kodesh bishgaga", vaachila bichzayit.
Veabba shaul, may tama? amar kera: "venatan", veen netina pachot mishshave peruta. veiddach name, ha ketiv "yochal"! hahu, perat lemazzik hu daata.
Vetanna kamma, hachtiv "venatan"! hahu mibbee leh ledavar harauy lihyot kodesh (perat laochel terumat chametz bappesach).

Tanu rabbanan: haochel teruma pachot mikkezayit — meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh. hechi dame? i delet beh shave peruta — keren name la lishallem, vei deit be shave peruta — chomesh name lishallem! leolam deit be shave peruta, vaafillu hachi, kevan delet beh kezayit — meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh.

Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav pappa ha dela keabba shaul, dei keabba shaul, haamar: kevan sheyyesh bah shave peruta, af al gav delet beh kezayit. amar lehu rav pappa: afillu tema abba shaul, abba shaul tarte bae.

Umi bae abba shaul tarte? veha tenan, abba shaul omer: et sheyyesh bo shave peruta — chayyayv betashlumin, et sheen bo shave peruta — eno chayyayv betashlumin. amru lo: lo amru shave peruta ella leinyan meila bilvad, aval litruma — eno chayyayv ad sheyyehe bo kezayit. veim ita, "kevan sheyyesh bo kezayit" mibbee leh. teyuveta.

Veaf rav pappa hadar beh, detanya: "vechata bishgaga" — perat lemezid. vahalo din hu: uma shear mitzvot shechayyayv bahen karet — poter bahen et hammezid, meila sheen bah karet — eno din sheppatar et hammezid?
Lo! im amarta bishar mitzvot shekken lo chiyyev bahen mita, tomar bimila, shechiyyev bah mita! talmud lomar: "bishgaga" — perat lemezid.
Vaamar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav chiyyay bar avin: hay tanna meikkara allima leh karet, ulevassof allima leh mita!

Vaamar leh, hachi kaamar: lo! im amarta bishar mitzvot — shekken lo chiyyev bahen mita befachot mikkezayit, tomar bimila — shechiyyev bah mita befachot mikkezayit. vaamar leh: tanuach datecha shehinnachta et dati. vaamar leh: may nichuta, derabba verav sheshet shadu beh narga: man shamat leh deamar

a: Hezid bimila bemita — rabbi hi, detanya: hezid bimila, rabbi omer: bemita, vachachamim omrim: baazhara.
May tama derabbi? amar rabbi avahu: gamar "chet" "chet" mitteruma. ma teruma bemita — af meila bemita.
Uminna: ma teruma bichzayit af meila bichzayit!
Umatkif la rav pappa: mimmay derabbi kerabbanan sevira leh? dilma keabba shaul sevira leh, deamar: yesh bah shave peruta — af al gav delet ba kezayit.
Veha rav pappa hu deamar deabba shaul tarte bae, ella shema minna: hadar beh.

Mar bereh deravna amar, hachi kaamar: lo! im amarta bishar mitzvot — shello asa bahen sheen mitkavven kemitkavven, sheim nitkavven lachtoch et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar — sheppatur, tomar bimila, sheim nitkavven lehitchammem begizze chullin venitchammem begizze ola — shemmaal.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar, hachi kaamar: lo! im amarta bishar mitzvot, shekken lo mitchayyev bahen sheen mitassek kemitassek, sheim nitkavven lehagebiah et hattalush, vechatach et hamechubbar — sheppatur. tomar bimila, sheim hoshit yado lichli littol chefetz vesach yado beshemen shel kodesh — shemmaal.
Amar mar: bamme devarim amurim — bemafrish teruma vehechmitza, aval hifrish chametz teruma — divre hakkol enah kedosha.
Mena hane mille? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, amar kera: "titten lo" — velo leuro.

Metiv rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: en tormin min hattemea lattehora, veim taram beshogeg — terumato teruma. veammay? lema: "lo" velo leuro! la kashya: hatam hayta lo sheat hakkosher, hacha lo hayta lo sheat hakkosher.

Udelo hayta lo sheat hakkosher, hechi dame? kegon deachmetz bimchubbar. aval achmetz betalush — hachi name dekadsha? amar leh: in, "bigzerat irin pitgama uvememar kaddishin sheelta", vechen morin beve midresha kevoti.
Ki ata rav huna bereh derav yehoshua,
b: Amar: amar kera "reshit" — sheshsheyareha nikkarin leyisrael, yatzta zo sheen sheyareha nikkarin.

Yatev rav acha bar rav avya kammeh derav chisda, veyatev veamar mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: anavim shennitmeu — dorchan pachot pachot mikkevetza, veyenan kasher linsachin. alma kasavar: mashkin mifkad pekidi, leemat ka mittammei — lechi sachet lehu. lechi sachet lehu leteh leshiureh.
I hachi, kevetza name? dehatnan: teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim kevetza mechuvvevnet — tehorin! hatam — dei avad, hacha — lechattechilla. gezera dilma ate lemebad yoter mikkevetza.
Amar leh rav chisda: man tzayet lach ulerabbi yochanan rabbach? vechi tumea shebbahen lehechan halcha? alma ka savar: mashkin mivla belii. vechevan deittammo leh uchela, ittammo leh mashkin.

Amar leh: veat la tisbera demashkin mifkad pekidi? vehatnan: teme met shessachat zetim vaanavim mechuvvevnet kevetza — tehorin. i amrat bishlama mifkad pekidi — mishshum hachi tehorin, ella i amrat mivla belii — ammay tehorin?

Amar leh: hacha bemay askinan, baanavim shello hucheshru. leemat mittachsheri? lechi sachet lehu. ki sachet lehu — betzir lehu shiura. dei la tema hachi, ha detanya: ha lema ze dome — litrumat tutin (zetim) vaanavim shennitmea, sheen lo bah lo hetter achila velo hetter hassaka. ha hetter achila name it beh, dei bae darech lehu pachot pachot mikkevetza.

Amar rava: gezera dilma ate behu lide takkala. amar leh abbaye: umi chayyshinan letakkala? veha tanya: madlikin befat uveshemen shel teruma shennitmet. amar leh: pat — zarek leh ben haetzim. shemen shel teruma — rame leh bichli maus.

Gufa: madlikin befat uveshemen shel teruma shennitmet. abbaye amar mishshemeh dechizkiyya, verava amar deve rabbi yitzchak bar marta amar rav huna: lo shanu ella pat, aval chitte — lo, shemma yavo bahen lide takkala. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu chitte. veammay? nechush dilma ate bahen lide takkala! kidamar rav ashe:

a: Bishlikata umeisata, hachi name bishlikata umeisata. vehecha ittemar derav ashe? aha deamar rabbi avin bar rav acha amar rabbi yitzchak: abba shaul gabbal shel bet rabbi haya, vehayu mechammin lo chammin bechittin shel teruma temea lalush bahen issa betohora. ammay? nechush dilma ate behu lide takkala! amar rav ashe: bishlikata umeisata.

Abbaye bar avin verav chananya bar avin tanu terumot be rabba. pega behu rava bar matna, amar lehu: may amritu bitrumot deve mar? amaru leh: umay kashya lach? amar lehu, tenan: shetile terumot shennitmeu ushetalan — tehorim milletamme, vaasurin milleechol (bitruma). vechi meachar dithorin milletamme, ammay asurin milleechol?
Amaru leh, hachi amar rabba: may asurin — asurin lezarim. umay ka mashma lan: giddule teruma — teruma? tenena: giddule teruma — teruma!

Vechi tema giddule giddulin, umay ka mashma lan — bedavar sheen zaro kale. ha name tenena: hattevel — giddulav muttarin, bedavar shezzaro kale. aval bedavar sheen zaro kale — afillu giddule giddulin asurin baachila. ishtiku.
Amaru leh: midde shemia lach beha? amar lehu, hachi amar rav sheshet: may asurin — asurin lechohanim, hoil veippesilu lehu behessach haddaat.
Hanicha leman deamar hessach haddaat pesul hagguf have — shappir, ella leman deamar hessach haddaat pesul tumea have — may ikka lememar?!
Deittemar: hessach haddaat, rabbi yochanan amar: pesul tumea have, verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: pesul hagguf have.
Rabbi yochanan amar pesul tumea have: sheim yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna — shomin lo. rabbi shimon ben lakish omer pesul hagguf have: sheim yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna — en shomin lo.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan lerabbi shimon ben lakish, rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: lul katan haya ben kevesh lammizbeach bemaaravo shel kevesh, sheshsham hayu zorkin pesule chattat haof, uteubbar tzuratan, veyotzin levet hasserefa. i amrat bishlama pesul tumea have, mishshum hachi bae ibbur tzura, shemma yavo eliyyahu vitaharenna. ella i amrat pesul hagguf, lema li ibbur tzura? vehatnan, ze hakkelal:
b: Kol sheppesulo begufo — yissaref miyyad. baddam uvabbealim — teubbar tzuratan veyotzin levet hasserefa. amar leh: hay tanna, tanna deve rabba bar avu hu, deamar: afillu piggul taun ibbur tzura.
Etiveh: nitma o shennifsal habbasar, o sheyyatza chutz lakkelaim, rabbi eliezer omer: yizrok, rabbi yehoshua omer: lo yizrok. umode rabbi yehoshua sheim zarak — huretza.
May nifsal — lav behessach haddaat? i amrat bishlama pesule tumea have, hayeynu demashkachat la dimratztze tzitz. ella i amrat pesul hagguf have, ammay huretza (tzitz)?
May nifsal, nifsal bitvul yom. i hachi, hayeynu tame! tere gavvne tame.

Ki selek ravin, amra lishmateh kammeh derabbi yirmeya, vaamar: bavlae tafshae, mishshum deyatvi beara dachashocha amritun shematata dimchashshechu. la shemia lechu ha derabbi shimon ben lakish mishshemeh derabbi oshaya:
Me hachag shennitmeu, hishshikan veachar kach hikdishan — tehorin, hikdishan veachar kach hishshikan — temeim.
Mikkede zeria ninhu, ma li hishshikan veachar kach hikdishan, ma li hikdishan veachar kach hishshikan? alma: en zeria lehekdesh. hacha name, en zeria litruma.
Yatev rav dimi vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh abbaye: hikdishan bichli kaamar, aval bappe la avud rabbanan maala. o dilma bappe name avud rabbanan maala?

Amar leh: zo lo shamati, kayyotze bah shamati. deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: anavim shennitmeu, derachan veachar kach hikdishan — tehorim. hikdishan veachar kach derachan — temein. veha anavim dikdushshat pe ninhu, vaafillu hachi avud rabbanan maala.
Amar rav yosef: anavim kaamrat? hacha baanavim shel teruma askinan, dikdushshat pe didhu — kikdushshat keli damya. aval hane devae keli, bappe la avud rabbanan maala.
Derachan — vaafillu tuva?! umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi, vehaamar rabbi yochanan: anavim shennitmeu — dorchan pachot pachot mikkevetza!
Ibbaet ema: hacha name pachot pachot mikkevetza. veibbaet ema: hatam denagu lehu berishon, dehavu lehu inhu sheni. hacha denagu besheni, dehavu lehu shelishi.
Amar rava, af anan name tenena: "venatan alav mayim chayyim el keli" — shettehe chiyyutan bichli. "venatan", alma telushin ninhu. veha mechubbarin ninhu!

a: Ella maala. hachi name — maala.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe, af anan name tenena: taval veala — ochel bemaaser. heeriv shimsho — ochel bitruma. bitruma in, bekadashim la. ammay, tahor hu? ella maala. hachi name — maala.
Amar rav ashe, af anan name tenena: "vehabbasar", lerabbot et haetzim ulevona. etzim ulevona bene ittammoye ninhu?! ella maala. hacha name — maala.

Mishna ellu devarim sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bappesach: bechittim, bisorim, bechussemin uveshifon uveshibbolet shual. veyotzin bidmay uvemaaser rishon shennittela terumato, uvemaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu. vehakkohanim bachalla uvatteruma.

Aval lo betevel, velo bemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, velo bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. challot hattoda urekike nazir, asaan leatzmo — en yotze bahen. asaan limkor bashshuk — yotzin bahen.
Gemara tana: kussemin — min chittin, shibbolet shual veshifon — min seorin. kussemin — guleba, shifon — dishra, shibbolet shual — shuvyle taala. hane in, orez vedochan — la.

Menahane mille? amar rabbi shimon ben lakish, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael, vechen tana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: amar kera "lo tochal alav chametz shivat yamim tochal alav matztzot". devarim habbaim lide chimmutz — adam yotze bahen yede chovato bematztza, yatzu ellu sheen bain lide chimmutz, ella lide sirchon.
Matnitin dela kerabbi yochanan ben nuri, deamar: orez min dagan hu, vechayyayvin al chimmutzo karet. detanya, rabbi yochanan ben nuri oser beorez vedochan mippene shekkarov lehachemitz.
Ibbaya lehu "shekkarov lehachemitz"? dekadem umachmitz, o dilma: "karov lehachemitz" — have, chametz gamur — la have.
Ta shema, detanya, amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: orez min dagan hu vechayyayvin al chimmutzo karet, veadam yotze bo yede chovato bappesach.
Vechen haya rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: karmit chayyevet bechalla. may karmit? amar abbaye: shetznita. may shetznita? amar rav pappa: shetznita demishtachcha bene kallanyata.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar resh lakish: issa shennillosha beyayin veshemen udevash — en chayyayvin al chimmutzah karet. yatev rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua kammeh derav idi bar avin, veyatev rav idi bar avin veka menamnem. amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: may tama deresh lakish?

Amar leh, deamar kera: "lo tochal alav chametz [vegomer]". devarim sheadam yotze bahen yede chovato bematztza — chayyayvin al chimmutzo karet. veha, hoil veen adam yotze bah yede chovato, dehavya lay matztza ashira — en chayyayvin al chimmutzah karet.

Etiveh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: himchahu ugemao, im chametz hu — anush karet, veim matztza hu — en adam yotze yede chovato bappesach. veha hacha, deen adam yotze yede chovato bematztza, vechayyayvin al chimmutzo karet?
Ittear behu rav idi bar avin, amar lehu: dardeke, hayeynu tama deresh lakish: mishshum dehavu lehu me ferot,
b: Ume ferot en machmitzin.
Yotze bidmay uvemaaser vechulei. demay ha la chaze leh! kevan dei bae mafkar lenichseh have ani veochel demay — hasheta name chaze leh.
Ditnan: maachilin et haaniyyim demay, veet achsanya demay. veamar rav huna: tana bet shammay omrim: en maachilin et haaniyyim demay veet haachsanya demay, uvet hillel omrim: maachilin.
Maaser rishon shennittela terumato vechulei. peshita! dechevan shennittela terumato chullin have!
La tzericha — shehikdimo beshibbolim, venittela hemennu terumat maaser velo nittela hemennu teruma gedola, vechidrabbi avahu.

Deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: maaser rishon shehikdimo beshibbolim — patur mitteruma gedola, shenneemar: "vaharemotem mimmennu terumat Adonai maaser min hammaaser". maaser min hammaaser amarti lecha, velo teruma gedola uterumat maaser min hammaaser.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ella meatta, afillu hikdimo bichri name lippetar? amar leh: alecha amar kera "mikkol mattenotechem tarimu et kol terumat Adonai".
Uma raita?! hay iddegan, vehay la iddegan.
Maaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu vechulei. peshita! hacha bemay askinan, shennatan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh. veka mashma lan deen chomesh meakkev.
Vehakkohanim bechalla uvitruma vechulei. peshita! mahu detema: matztza shava lechol adam baenan, ka mashma lan — "matztzot" "matztzot" ribba.
Aval lo betevel vechulei. peshita! la tzericha, betevel tavul midderabbanan shezzerao beatzitz sheeno nakuv.
Velo bemaaser rishon shello nittela terumato. peshita! la tzericha, shehikdimo bichri.
Mahu detema kedaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye, ka mashma lan kidshanni leh.
Velo bemaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu vechulei. peshita!
Leolam denifdu, umay lo nifdu — shello nifdu kehilchatan: maaser sheni sheppedao al gav asimon, derachamana amar: "vetzarta hakkesef" — davar sheyyesh lo tzura.
Vehekdesh shechillelo al gabbe karka, derachamana amar: "venatan hakkesef vekam lo".
Tanu rabbanan: yachol yotze adam yede chovato betevel shello nitkan. kol tevel name ha lo nitkan!
Ella: betevel shello nitkan kol tzorko. shennittela mimmennu teruma gedola velo nittela mimmennu terumat maaser, [maaser] rishon velo maaser sheni, vaafillu masar ani, minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "lo tochal alav chametz" — mi sheissuro mishshum "bal tochal alav chametz", yatza ze sheen issuro mishshum "bal tochal chametz", ella mishshum "bal tochal tevel".
Veissura dechametz lehechan azala? amar rav sheshet: ha manni, rabbi shimon hi, deamar: en issur chal al issur. detanya, rabbi shimon omer:

a: Haochel nevela beyom hakkippurim — patur.
Ravina amar, afillu tema rabbanan: mi sheissuro mishshum "bal tochal chametz" bilvad. yatza ze sheen issuro mishshum "bal tochal chametz" bilvad, ella af mishshum "bal tochal tevel".
Midde "bilvad" ketiv? ella mechavvavrta kidrav sheshet.

Tanu rabbanan: yachol yotze adam yede chovato bemaaser sheni birushalayim, talmud lomar: "lechem oni", ma shenneechol baaninut. yatza ze sheeno neechol baaninut, ella besimcha — divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Rabbi akiva omer: "matztzot" "matztzot" ribba. im ken, ma talmud lomar "lechem oni"? perat leissa shennillosha beyayin veshemen udevash.
May tama derabbi akiva: mi ketiv "lechem oni"? "ani" ketiv.
Verabbi yose haggelili: mi karenan "ani"! "oni" karenan. verabbi akiva: hay dekarenan beh "oni", kedishmuel. deamar shemuel: "lechem oni" — lechem sheonin alav devarim harebe.

Vesavar rabbi akiva issa shennillosha beyayin veshemen udevash la? vehatanya: en lashin issa bappesach beyayin veshemen udevash. veim lash, rabban gamliel omer: tissaref miyyad, vachachamim omrim: yeachel. veamar rabbi akiva: shabbatti hayta etzel rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, velashti lahem issa beyayin veshemen udevash, velo amru li davar.
Veaf al pi sheen lashin, mekattefin bo — atan letanna kamma. vachachamim omrim: et shellashin bo — mekattefin bo. veet sheen lashin bo — en mekattefin bo. veshavin sheen lashin et haissa befoshrin!
La kashya: ha — beyom tov rishon. ha — beyom tov sheni.

Kedaamar lehu rabbi yehoshua livneh: yoma kamma la telushu li bachalava, mikkan veelach lushu li bachalava. vehatanya: en lashin et haissa bechalav, veim lash — kol happat asura, mippene hergel avera. ella hachi kaamar: yoma kamma la telushu li beduvesha, mikkan veelach — lushu li beduvesha.
Veibbaet ema: leolam bachalava, kedaamar ravina: keen tora — shere. hacha name keen tora.
Veshavin sheen lashin et haissa befoshrin. may shena mimmenachot, ditnan: kol hammenachot nilloshot befoshrin, (umishtammerin) shello yechmetzu. im amru bizrizin, yomru besheen zerizin?
I hachi, miltat name latet! allema amar rabbi zera amar rabba bar yirmeya amar shemuel: chittin shel menachot en lottin otah! lisha bizrizin ita, letita leta bizrizin.
Velisha mi ita bizrizin? vehachtiv: "veyatzak aleha shemen vegomer veheviah el hakkohen" — mikkemitza veelach mitzvat kehunna, limmed al yetzika uvelila shekkeshera bechol adam!
Lisha, nehi devizrizin leta, bimkom zerizin ita. deamar mar: belila keshera bezar, chutz lechomat azara — pesula. leappoke letita — deenah bizrizin, vela bimkom zerizin.
Umay shena mimminchat haomer? detanya: minchat haomer lottin otah vetzovrin otah! tzibbur shane.

Tanu rabbanan: yachol yotze adam yede chovato bevikkurim? talmud lomar: "bechol moshvotechem tochlu matztzot" — matztza hanneechelet bechol moshvotechem, yatzu bikkurim sheen neechalin bechol moshvotechem ella birushalayim, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Rabbi akiva omer: matztza umaror; ma maror sheeno bikkurim, af matztza sheenah bikkurim. i: ma maror sheen bemino bikkurim, af matztza sheen beminah bikkurim!
b: Otzi chittin useorin sheyyesh beminan bikkurim. talmud lomar: "matztzot" "matztzot" ribba. i "matztzot" "matztzot" ribba, afillu bikkurim name! hadar beh rabbi akiva.

Detanya: yachol yetze adam yede chovato bevikkurim, talmud lomar: "bechol moshvotechem tochlu matztzot" — matztza hanneechelet bechol moshavot, yatzu bikkurim sheenan neechalin bechol moshavot ella birushalayim. yachol sheani motzi af maaser sheni, talmud lomar: "matztzot" "matztzot" ribba.
