Uma raita lerabbot maaser sheni ulehotzi bikkurim? merabbe ani maaser sheni sheyyesh lo hetter bechol moshavot, kidrabbi (eliezer), umotzi ani bikkurim sheen lahen hetter bechol moshavot.
Deamar rabbi (eliezer): minyan lemaaser sheni shennitma, sheppodin oto afillu birushalayim, talmud lomar: "ki lo tuchal seeto".
Veen "seet" ella achila — shenneemar: "vayyissa masot meet panav".
Man shamat leh deamar bemaaser sheni nafek beh? rabbi akiva, vekammaet lehu levikkurim "mibbechol moshvotechem", shema minna hadar beh.
Verabbi yose haggelili, tippok leh millechem oni" — mi shenneechol beoni, yatza ze sheen neechol ella besimcha?
Savar leh kerabbi shimon. detanya: bikkurim asurin leonen, verabbi shimon mattir.
May tama derabbanan — dichtiv: "lo tuchal leechol bisharecha", veamar mar: "terumat yadecha" ellu bikkurim, deittakkash bikkurim lemaaser: ma maaser asur leonen — af bikkurim asur leonen.
Verabbi shimon: "teruma" kerinhu rachamana. kitruma: ma teruma mutteret leonen — af bikkurim muttar leonen.
Verabbi shimon, nehi dehekkesh let leh, simcha miha michtav ketiva behu. dichtiv: "vesamachta vechol hattov"?
Hahu lizman simcha hu daata, ditnan: meatzeret vead hachag — mevi vekore, mehachag vead chanukka — mevi veeno kore.

Tanu rabbanan: "lechem oni" — perat lechalut velaashisha. yachol lo yetze adam yede chovato ella befat haderaa? talmud lomar: "matztzot" "matztzot" ribba, vaafillu kematztzot shel shelomo. im ken, ma talmud lomar "lechem oni" — perat lechalut velaashisha.
Umay mashma dehay ashisha lishshana dachashivuta, dichtiv: "vaychallek lechol haam lechol hamon yisrael lemeish vead ishsha leish challat lechem achat veeshpar echad vaashisha echat vegomer".
Veamar rav chanan bar abba: "eshpar" — echad mishshishsha bappar, "ashisha" — echad mishshishsha baefa. vfliga dishmuel, deamar shemuel: "ashisha" — garba dechamra, dichtiv: "veohave ashishe anavim".
Tanu rabbanan: en ofin pat ava (beyom tov) bappesach, divre bet shammay,

a: Uvet hillel mattirin. vechamma pat ava? amar rav huna: tefach, shekken matzinu belechem happanim tefach.
Matkef la rav yosef: im amru bizrizin — yomru besheenan zerizin? im amru befat amila — yomru befat sheenah amila?
Im amru beetzim yeveshin — yomru beetzim lachim? im amru betannur cham — yomru betannur tzonen? im amru betannur shel mattechet — yomru betannur shel cheres?

Amar rav yirmeya bar abba: sheelit et rabbi beyichud, umannu: rav. ikka deamri, rav yirmeya bar abba amar rav: sheelit et rabbi beyichud, umannu: rabbenu hakkadosh. may pat ava? pat merubba. veammay karu leh pat ava? mishshum dinfisha belisha. vei baet ema, beatreh dehay tanna lefat merubba — pat ava karu leh.
May tama? i mishshum deka tarach tircha dela tzerich, may irya befesach? afillu beyom tov name!
In hachi name, vehay tanna beyom tov shel pesach kae. tanya name hachi, bet shammay omrim: en ofin pat ava beyom tov, uvet hillel mattirin.

Tanu rabbanan: yotzin befat nekiyya, uvehadraa, uvisrikin hametzuyyayrin bappesach, af al pi sheamru en osin serikin hametzuyyayrin bappesach. amar rav yehuda: davar ze shaal bayytos ben zonin lachachamim: mippene ma amru en osin serikin hametzuyyayrin bappesach? amru lo: mippene shehaishsha shoha aleha umechammatztah.
Amar lahem: efshar yaasenna bidfus veyikbaenna kevan! amru lo: yomru kol hasserikin — asurin, userike bayytos — muttarin.

Amar rabbi elazar bar tzadok: paam achat nichnasti achar abba levet rabban gamliel, veheviu lefanav serikin hametzuyyayrin bappesach. amarti: abba, lo kach amru chachamim, en osin serikin hametzuyyayrin bappesach? amar li: beni, lo shel kol adam amru, ella shel nachtomin amru.
Ikka deamri, hachi kaamar leh: lo shel nachtomin amru, ella shel kol adam. amar rabbi yose: osin serikin kemin rekikin, veen osin serikin kemin gelusekaot.
Tanu rabbanan: hassufeganin vehadduveshanin veiskeritin vechallat hammasret vehamedumma — peturim min hachalla. may challat hammasret? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ze chalut shel baale vattim.
Amar resh lakish: hallalu maase ilpas hen. verabbi yochanan amar: maase ilpas chayyayvin. vehallalu sheasaan bachamma.

Metivi: hassufeganin vehadduveshanin vehaiskeritin, asaan beilpas — chayyayvin, bachamma — peturin, teyuveteh derabbi shimon ben lakish! amar ulla: amar lecha rabbi shimon ben lakish, hacha bemay askinan — shehirtiach ulevassof hidbik.

Aval hidbik ulevassof hirtiach, may? hachi name difturin, addetane sefa: asaan bachamma peturin, liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — kegon shehirtiach ulevassof hidbik, aval hidbik ulevassof hirtiach — peturin?
Chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim — shehirtiach ulevassof hidbik, aval hidbik ulevassof hirtiach — naasa kemi sheasaan bachamma, ufeturin.
Ta shema: yotzin bematztza hina uvematztza haasuya beilpas. hacha name, shehirtiach ulevassof hidbik.
May matztza hina? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol shepporsah veen chutin nimshachin hemenna. amar rava: vechen lachme toda. peshita, hacha "lechem" ketiv, vehacha "lechem" ketiv!
Mahu detema, hoil uchetiv "vehikriv mimmennu
b: Echad mikkol korban", "echad" — shello yittol parus, vehacha keman difrisa damya, ka mashma lan.

Metivi: hammeissa — bet shammay potrin, uvet hillel mechayyeyvin. hachalita — bet shammay mechayyeyvin, uvet hillel potrin. ezehu hammeissa veezehu hachalita? hammeissa — kemach sheal gabbe mugelashin, hachalita — mugelashin sheal gabbe kemach.
Rabbi yishmael berabbi yose omer mishshum aviv: ze vaze liftur, veamri la: ze vaze lechiyyuv, vachachamim omrim: echad ze veechad ze, asaan beilpas — patur, betannur — chayyayv.

Vetanna kamma, may shena hammeissa umay shena chalita? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, vechen amar rav yehuda veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kemachaloket bezo kach machaloket bezo, vetavra, mi sheshshana zo lo shana zo.

Katane mihat: vachachamim omrim echad ze veechad ze sheasaan beilpas — patur, betannur — chayyayv, teyuveta derabbi yochanan! amar lach rabbi yochanan: tannae hi. detanya: yachol yehe meissa vachaluta chayyayvin bachalla, talmud lomar: "lechem".

Rabbi yehuda omer: en lechem ella haafuy betannur. rabbi yehuda hayeynu tanna kamma! ella lav, maase ilpas ikka benayyhu, tanna kamma savar: maase ilpas chayyayvin, verabbi yehuda savar: maase ilpas peturin.

La, dechulle alma maase ilpas peturin, vehacha kegon shechazar vaafao betannur ka mippalgi. detanna kamma savar: kevan shechazar vaafao betannur — lechem karenan beh, verabbi yehuda savar: en lechem ella haafuy betannur meikkara, vechevan demeikkara lav betannur afiyyay — lav lechem hu.
Amar rava: may tama derabbi yehuda, dichtiv: "veafu eser nashim lachmechem betannur echad". lechem haafuy betannur echad — karuy lechem, vesheen afuy betannur echad — en karuy lechem.

Yatev rabba verav yosef achoreh derabbi zera, veyatev rabbi zera kammeh deulla. amar leh rabba lerabbi zera, bei minneh meulla: hidbik mibbifnim vehirtiach mibbachutz, mahu? amar leh: may ema leh? dei amena leh, amar li: he nihu maase ilpas!
Amar leh rav yosef lerabbi zera, beo minneh meulla: hidbik mibbifnim vaavuka kenegdo, mahu? amar leh: may ema leh? dei amena leh, amar li: rov aniyyim osin ken.
Amar rav assi: issa shel maaser sheni, ledivre rabbi meir — petura min hachalla, ledivre chachamim — chayyevet bechalla.

a: Matztzot shel maaser sheni, ledivre rabbi meir — en adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach, ledivre chachamim — yotze bah yede chovato bappesach.
Etrog shel maaser sheni, ledivre rabbi meir — en yotze bo yede chovato beyom tov, ledivre chachamim — adam yotze bo yede chovato beyom tov.
Matkef la rav pappa: bishlama issa, dichtiv "arisotechem" — mishshellachem.
Etrog name, dichtiv "ulekachtem lachem", "lachem" — mishshellachem yehe. ella matztza, mi ketiv "matztzatchem"?

Amar rava, veittema rav yemar bar shelemya: atya "lechem" "lechem". ketiv hacha "lechem oni", uchetiv hatam "vehaya baacholchem millechem haaretz". ma lehallan — mishshellachem, af kan — mishshellachem.
Lema mesayyay leh: issa shel maaser sheni petura min hachalla, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: chayyevet. lema mesayyay?! hayeynu hach!
Hachi kaamar (leh): lema middifligi beissa, behanach name peligi. o dilma, shane hatam dichtiv "arisotechem" "arisotechem" tere zimne.

Bae rabbi shimon ben lakish: mahu sheyyetze adam yede chovato bechalla shel maaser sheni birushalayim? allibba derabbi yose haggelili — la tibbee lach, hasheta bechullin la nafek, bechallato mibbaya?! ki tibbee lach allibba derabbi akiva.
Bechullin hu denafek — dei mittammu yesh lahen hetter bemoshavot. aval challa, dei mittammeya let la hetter bemoshavot, velisrefa azla — la nafek.
O dilma: amrinan hoil veillu lo kara aleha shem veittammay — it lah hetter bemoshavot, venafek bah, hasheta name nafek.
Ikka deamri: ha vadday la tibbee lach, devadday amrinan "hoil". ki tibbee lach challa hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni.
Veallibba derabbanan la tibbee lach, kevan deamri yippade — hayeynu maaser. ki tibbee lach, allibba derabbi yehuda, deamar — yikkaver.
Ditnan: hallakuach bechesef maaser sheni shennitma — yippade. rabbi yehuda omer: yikkaver.
Mi amrinan: hoil vei la lakuach have, vehoil velo kara aleha shem veittammay — yesh lo hetter bemoshavot, venafek beh, hasheta name nafek beh.
O dilma: chad "hoil" amrinan, tere "hoil" la amrinan? amar rava: mistabbera shem maaser chad hu.
Challat toda urekike nazir vechulei. mena hane mille? amar rabba: deamar kera
b: "Ushemartem et hammatztzot" — matztza hammishtammeret leshem matztza. yatzta zo sheen mishtammeret leshem matztza, ella leshum zevach.
Rav yosef amar, amar kera: "shivat yamim matztzot tochelu" — matztza hanneechelet leshivat yamim. yatzta zo sheenah neechelet leshivat yamim, ella leyom valayla.

Tanya kevoteh derabba, vetanya kevoteh derav yosef. tanya kevoteh derabba: yachol yetze yede chovato bechallot toda urekike nazir, talmud lomar: "ushemartem et hammatztzot" — matztza hammishtammeret leshem matztza. yatzta zo sheenah mishtammeret leshem matztza, ella leshum zevach.

Tanya kevoteh derav yosef: yachol yetze adam yede chovato bechallot toda urekike nazir, talmud lomar: "shivat yamim matztzot tochelu" — matztza hanneechelet leshiva. yatzta zo sheenah neechelet leshiva, ella leyom valayla.
Vetippok leh millechem oni" — mi shenneechol baaninut. yatza ze sheeno neechol baaninut, ella besimcha!
Savar la kerabbi akiva, deamar "ani" ketiv.
Vetippok leh dehave leh matztza ashira!
Amar shemuel bar rav yitzchak: reviit hi, umitchalleket hi lechamma challot.
Vetippok leh deenan neechalot bechol moshavot!
Amar resh lakish: zot omeret challot toda urekike nazir neechalin benov vegivon.

Tanya, amar rabbi ilay: shaalti et rabbi eliezer — mahu sheyyetze adam bechallot toda urekike nazir? amar li: lo shamati. bati veshaalti lifne rabbi yehoshua, amar li: hare amru, challot toda urekike nazir sheasaan leatzmo — en adam yotze bahen, limkor bashshuk — yotze bahen.

Keshebbati vehirtzeti devarim lifne rabbi eliezer, amar li: berit! hen hen haddevarim shenneemru lo lemoshe besinay. ikka deamri: berit, hen hen haddevarim shenneemru lo lemoshe besinay? vela tama baaya?!
Vetama may? amar rabba: kol lashshuk immeloche mimmelech. amar: i mizdabban — mizdabban, i la mizdabban — ippok behu ana.
